mdo rje/ 6) (54)0138 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 3dang po/ 'tshe ba med pa'i phung po'i le'u/ 3gnyis pa/ rdo rje ltar mi shigs pa'i sku'i phung po zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 99gsum pa/ mdo'i ming gi gtan tshigs dang yon tan gyi tshul gyi le'u/ 111bzhi pa/ byang chub sems dpa' sna grangs bzhis chos ston pa'i le'u/ 114lnga pa/ srin po la sogs pa 'dus pas zhus pa zhes bya ba'i le'u/ 177rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /dzñā na ga dang / zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba ban+de de ba tsan dras bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(347 bsdur 'bras re'u mig(376)0139 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po'i mdo/ 377

zhu chen gyi lots+tsha ba dge slong rin chen bzang pos bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(382) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(383)0140 'phags pa 'da' ka ye shes zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 384bsdur mchan/(386) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(386)0141 sangs rgyas kyi mdzod kyi chos kyi yi ge/ 387dang po/ chos so cog gi bden pa'i mtshan ma'i le'u/ 387gnyis pa/ sangs rgyas bsam pa'i le'u/ 387gsum pa/ chos bsam pa'i le'u/ 397bzhi pa/ dge 'dun bsam pa'i le'u/ 405lnga pa/ tshul khrims gtsang ma'i le'u/ 410drug pa/ gtsang ma'i chos kyi le'u/ 424bdun pa/ gna' 'das pa'i le'u/ 455brgyad pa/ gtsang ma mthong ba'i le'u/ 466dgu pa/ dogs pa bye brag phyed pa'i le'u/ 480bcu pa/ bcol ba'i le'u/ 490bsdur mchan/(530) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(552)0142 'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 5532

rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi na mi tra dang /su ren dra bo rnyi dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sdes zhus te skad gsar chad kyis bcos nas slad kyis gtan la phab/bsdur mchan/(740) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(757)0143 'phags pa gser gyi mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ 758bsdur mchan/(759) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(760)0144 'phags pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo / 761rgya gar gyi mkhan po su ren+d+ra bo dhe dang /pradzñā barma dang / zhu chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de ye shes sde la sogs pas bsgyur/bsdur mchan/(768) bsdur 'bras re'u mig(769)
ri

༄ga /'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya ma hā pa ri nidzā ṇa nā ma ma hā yā 2na sru tra / bod skad du/ 'phags pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po theg nga/ 3chen po'i mdo/ bam po dang po/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/bcom ldan 'das grong khyer ku shi na/ chu klung gser ldan gyi 'gram/ gyad kyi nyen kor shing sā 4la zung gi tshal na bzhugs te/ de na ru bcom ldan 'das dge slong bye ba 'bum phrag brgyad cus ( bskor cing mdun gyis bltas te/ dpyid zla tha chungs 8zla ba nya ba'i nang par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i dus dang nye bar gyur pa na/ sems can thams cad kyi rang rang gi yul gyi skad du shin tu zur phyin par don brda sprod pa'i tshig rnams kyis/ srid pa'i rtse mo man chad go bar mdzad de/ deng de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs 54—3

pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten thams cad la thugs brtse ba can/ 'jig rten thams cad skyob pa/ sems can thams cad la sgra gcan zin dang 'dra bar gzigs pa 1skyabs chen po'i gnas dang gzhi bor gyur pa thub pa chen po yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 2'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal te/ sems can thams cad kyi zhu ba lung bstan pa tha ma la de lta bu'i gsung rnams byung bar gyur to/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi zhal nas 'od zer sna tshogs 'di lta ste / sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / shel gyi kha dog dang / rdo'i snying po'i kha dog lta bu dag byung ste/ 'od zer de dag gis stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing thams cad du/ sems can dmyal ba dang / dud 'gro dang / yi dgas 3dang / lha ma yin dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sems can de dag la phog nas4/ de'i mod la nyon mongs pa'i mun pa thams cad dang / ngan song dang / mi khom pa thams cad rgyun chad par gyur to/ /de nas mya ngan chen pos non te tshig 'thun 5par kye ma khebs so khebs so zhes kyang zer to/ /kyi hud kyi hud ces kyang skad cher 'bod cing lag pa brkyang bas kyang mgo bo la rdobs shing 6lus 'dar zhing shin tu ngu'o/ /de'i tshe sa chen po nags tshal dang bcas ri dang bcas pa'i rgya mtsho'i mthas gtugs pa yang snye rab tu g.yos te/sems can de dag kyang gcig la gcig 'dzin cing 'di skad du grogs po dag rings grogs po dag rings/ rgyad yul gyi grong khyer ku shir 'dong ngo 'dong ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar gshegs pa las bzlog 8la bsgrim mi dgos par bskal pa'am bskal pa las 54—4

lhag par yang bzhugs par gsol ba gdab bo zhes zer to/ /gcig la gcig 'jus nas 'di skad du/ kye ma 'jig rten stongs par 'gyur ro/ / kye ma 'jig rten stongs par 'gyur ro/ /)kye ma sems can rnams kyi bsod nams kyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ni zad do/ /las mi bzad pa ni byung ngo / /tshe dang ldan pa dag myur 2cig /tshe dang ldan pa dag myur 5cig /de bzhin gshegs pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas deng gi yud tsam 'di la yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /kye ma 'jig rten stongs par 'gyur ro/ /kye ma 'jig rten stongs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa mi bzhugs na/bdag cag mgon med pa dang / rtsa lag med pa dang / phongs par ji ltar 4'gyur zhig gu/ bdag cag gi the tshom dang som nyi ci dang ci yod pa de dang de dag zhu bar bya'o zhes kyang zer to/ /nyan thos chen po 'di dag kyang de na 'khod de / 'di lta ste/ gnas brtan kā t+yā ra ya na chen po dang / gnas brtan bsku 6la dang / gnas brtan nye dga' bo dang / de dag la sogs pa gzhan dag kyang de na 'khod de/ de dag la 'od zer gyis phog 7rinas/ 'dar rab tu 'dar / dam dam rab tu dam dam/ 'khrugs rab tu 'khrugs/ brtabs rab tu brtabs/ 'ur 'ur rab tu bur 'ur/ 'khams rab tu 'khams/rmugs rab tu rmugs/ rengs rab tu rengs te/ de dag la sogs pa dag tu gyur nas chas so/ /de'i tshe dge slong sa ya phrag brgyad so shing zos nas phyir byung ste / gnas brtan de dag la 'od zer gyi snang ba des phog nas shin tu rings par kha gdong bkrus te gcig la gcig 'jus so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras de dag thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ dbang thob pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed 54—5

pa byas pa/ cang shes pa/ gtso bo chen po/ chen po stong pa nyid kyis rang gi don thob pa/ tsan dan chen po lta bu'i g.yog 'khor dang ldan pa/ seng ge 1lta bu'i g.yog 'khor dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ de la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa de dag thams cad snga dro nyi ma 'char kur yan lag thams cad kyi ba spu rgya skyegs kyi shing gi me tog ltar rtsa dmar ba ni langs/ mig ni mchi ma khrag lta bus gang ste/ mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba dang ldan nas/sems can thams cad la phan pa dang bde ba dang snying brtse ba'i phyir dang /gdul bar bya ba'i dbang gi don du theg pa chen po'i mchog tu gsang ba/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dgongs pa'i tshig rnam pa sna tshogs kyi chos kyi sgo'i tshul bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nate/ bcom ldan 'das la lan 'bum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 3logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de'i tshe ko ta ku'i bu mo rab bzangs cam la sogs pa dge slong ma bye ba 'bum phrag drug thams cad kyang dgra bcom pa/ zag pa zad pa/ dbang thob pa/ bya ba byas pa/ byed pa byas pa/khur bor ba/ nyon mongs pa med pa/ gtso mo chen mo/ chen po stong pa nyid kyis rang gi don thob pa sha stag ste/ 'di lta ste/ ko ta ku'i bu mo dge slong ma rab bzangs ci ma dang / dge slong ma nye dga' mo dang / dge slong ma rgya mtsho blo gros dang / de tshol sogs pa dge slong ma bye ba 'bum phrag drug snga dro nyi ma 'char kur yan lag thams cad kyi ba spu rgya skyegs kyi shing gi me tog ltar rtsa dmar ba ni langs/ mig ni mchi ma khrag lta bus gang ste/ mchog tu sdug 54—6

— —————————— ——————————— — — ———————wa ———————— ——— wa wa —— ——bsngal ba'i tshor ba dang ldan nas/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang /bde ba dang / snying brtse ba'i phyir dang / gdul bar bya ba'i 1dbang gi don du theg pa chen po'i mchog tu gsang ba/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dgongs pa'i tshig rnam pa sna tshogs kyi chos kyi sgo 'i tshul bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la lan 'bum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do / /'khor de na dge slong ma 'khod pa rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa' mi mchog sa bcu thob pa sha stag ste/ gdul ba'i dbang gi phyir bud med kyi gzugs dang / bud med kyi dbyibs dang / sha dang / khrag dang / rgyus pa mang po dang rus pa'i lus 'chang ba/ rtag tu tshad med pa bzhi bsgom pa dang ldan pa/ bdag nyid kyis sangs rgyas kyi yul gyi cho 'phrul chen po'i don byed nus pa sha stag go/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe byang chub sems dpa' rgya mtshos byin la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed thams cad kyang mi mchog sa bcu thob pa/ thabs kyis lus 'chang ba sha stag la 'di lta ste/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rgya mtshos byin dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po blo gros mi zad pa dang / de dag la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyang / theg pa chen po thos par 'dod pa/ theg pa chen po la zhugs pa/ theg pa chen pos bkres pa/theg pa chen po la sred pa/ theg pa chen po la ser sna med pa/ 'jig rten thams cad dang 'thun par byed nus pa sha stag dang / bdag cag /༷ /sa

gzhan bsgral bar bya'o snyam ste/ sngon gyi bskal pa bye ba snyed du tshul khrims kyi bkod pa'i dam bca' ba 1legs par blangs pa/ 'dzin pa'i spyad pa spyod pa sha stag dang / de bzhin du bdag cag grol nas gzhan dgrol bar bya'o snyam pa dang ske/ de bzhin du dkon mchog gsum gyi nagadung mi 'chad dpar bya'o snyam pa dang ske/ chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya'o snyam pa dang / go cha chen po bgo bar bya'o snyam du sems pa sha stag dang / de bzhin du yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa dang la/ bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la snyoms par lta ba sha stag ste/ de dag thams cad snga dro'i nyi ma 'char kur 5yan lag thams cad kyi ba spu rgya skyegs kyi shing gi me tog ltar rtsa dmar ba ni langs/ mig ni mchi ma khrag lta bus gang ste/ mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba dang ldan nas sems can thams cad la 'phan pa dang / bde ba dang / snying brtse ba'i phyir dang ske/ gdul bar bya ba'i dbang gi don du/ theg pa chen po'i mchog tu gsang ba stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dgongs pa'i tshig rnam pa sna tshogs kyi 7sgo'i tshul bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste lhags nas bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te bcom ldan 'das la lan 'bum bskor ba byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 8logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /yang de'i tshe bslab pa'i gzhi lnga blangs shing / tshul khrims dang / cho ga dang / yon tan dang 9ldan pa'i dge bsnyen 'od dri ma med par grags pa'i rgyal po la sogs pa dge bsnyen 1 gang gā'i klung gnyis kyi bye ma snyed thams cad kyang zung dang zung du shes par 'dod pa sha stag ste/ sdug bsngal ba dang / bde ba dang / rtag pa dang / mi rtag pa 54—8

wa wa————wa ——— —wa wa wa ——wa —— ————————— ———dang ske/ bdag yod pa dang / bdag med pa dang / stong pa dang / stong pa ma yin pa dang / de kho na dang / de kho na ma yin pa dang / skyabs dang /skyabs ma yin pa dang / sems can dang / sems can med pa dang / brtan pa dang / brtan pa ma yin pa dang / zhi ba dang / zhi ba ma yin pa dang /'dus byas dang / 'dus ma byas dang / ther zug dang / ther zug ma yin pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa ma yin pa la sogs pa'i khyad par dang khyad par du 'phags pa shes par 'dod pa sha stag ste/ 'di lta ste/ dge bsnyen 'od dri ma med par grags pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba dang / dge bsnyen rab sbyin la sogs pa dge bsnyen theg pa chen po thos par 'dod la/ thos nas kyang gzhan dag la bstan par bya'o snyam du dam bcas shing tshul khrims blangs pa/ theg pa chen pos skom la ngoms nas kyang gzhan skom pa dag ngoms 1par bya'o snyam du dam bcas pa/ theg pa chen po la sred pa/ theg pa chen po la ser sna med pa/ 'jig rten thams cad dang 'thun par byed nus pa sha stag dang / bdag cag rgal nas gzhan bsgral bar bya'o / /bdag cag grol nas gzhan dgrol bar bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi chad 2par bya'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya'o snyam du slob par 'dod pa/ go cha chen po bgos pa/ bslab pa rnams la sems gus pa dang /de bzhin du yon tan grangs med pa dang ldan pa/ bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la snying rje dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ de dag kyang nyi ma 'char kur de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i phyir re res kyang tsan dan dang / a ga ru dang / thang shing gi mchog dang / tsa/ 4da/ sa

mchog pa'i bud shing rnams dang / yam sreg 1shing dri bsung dang ldan pa yon tan can lnga stong lnga stong khyer te 'ongs so/ /de la yam sreg 2shing sna re zhing yang gser gyi skud pa rin po che sna bdun rigs bdun dang ldan pas spras pas dkris pa/ ri mo la bris pa kho na bzhin du 'dug pa/ rang bzhin gyis gzhon sha 3can legs par bcos pa sha stag ste/ sna re zhing yang 'od rnam pa sna tshogs dang ldan pa'i phung po chen po mdog sngo ba dang / bar bar kha cig tu mdog dkar / kha cig tu sngo skya/ kha cig tu rtsa dmar/ kha cig tu ser ba/ mig tu sdug par bya ba 4sha stag go/ /bam po re re'i g.yogs ma'i phyar bu yang rin po che sna bdun las byas pa sha stag go/ /rachings ma'i the gu mang po re re zhing yang ldong ros kyi mdog lta bu dang / zar ma'i me tog gi mdog lta bu dang / sngon po dang / ser po rnams kyis bar bar du spel ba sha stag go/ /de la chings ma'i the gu mang po re re zhing yang gser thags kyi mchog rnam par dag pa/ yul mang por grags pa dag gis spel ba sha stag go/ /de la yam sreg tshoshing sna re re 7zhing yang spos dri bsung zhim po dang / me tog phreng dang / gur gum gyi phye ma dang ldan par byas pa/ gser thags 8kyis g.yogs pa/ dar snas brgyan pa/rin po che sna bdun gyi shubs 0sngon po dang / ser po dang / sngo skya dang /dkar po dang / btsod ka lta bu dag gi nang du bcug pa/ yul ka ling ku'i ras dang / zar ma'i ras dang / zab dar dang / rgya dar gyi mchog rnams kyis dkris pa/ me tog mang pos brgyan pa/ byug pa dri bsung zhim po dag gis byugs pa sha stag go/ /yam sreg shing sna re'i shing rta re re zhing yang rin po che sna bdun gyis brgyan pa/ gser gyis mdzes par byas pa kha cig /kha 54—10

cig tu sngon po dang / dkar po dang / bab la'i kha dog dang / li khri'i kha dog pas lhag pa'i 'od gsal ba dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /shing rta de dag gi gnya' shing rnams kyang rin po che sna bdun gyis brgyan pa/ dpe med pa/ rta cang shes mgyogs pa dag dang sbyar ba sha stag go/ /rta de dag kyang rlung gi shugs pas mgyogs pa/ spu kha chu skyar gyi mdog dang / ldong ros kyi mdog dang /sprin gyi mdog can sha stag 1ste/ thabs de 'dra ba'i shing rta re re'i mdun logs dang rgyab logs su rgyal mtshan dang ba dan bsgreng ste/ rgyal mtshan thams cad kyang rin po che las byas pa/ gser gyi dra bas g.yogs pa sha stag go/ /rgyal mtshan gyi mdun logs su yang gdugs rtsibs dang rtsa ba nor bu dri ma med pa 'od can las byas pa/ mu tig gi chun po sbyangs 2pa sha stag khyer ro/ /gdugs re re'i mdun logs su yang gser gyi me tog ku mu da dang / ud pa la dang ske/ pad+ma dkar po sdong bu bai drur+ya 3las byas pa/ ze ba rdo rje las byas pa/bung ba mang po skad 'byin pa/ dri bsung zhim po dang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong ba/'od dang ldan pa/ che ba mang ba sha stag dang / lda ldi chen po sha stag khyer ro/ /lda ldi chen po rnams kyi mdun du yang byang chub sems dpa'i skyes pa'i rabs kyi spyod pa ri mor bris pa chen po dag thogs so/ /ri mo'i gzugs re re'i glo 4g.yas g.yon nas kyang / zlos gar gyi gar thabs yul dbus nas byung ba rnam pa sna tshogs byed de/ gar thabs byed pa de'i nang na sil snyan rin po che las byas pa'i rdza rnga dang / khar rnga dang / rnga zlum dang / pi bang tshodang / gling bu dang / pi bang snye rgyud gcig pa dang / rnga bo che dang / dung la sogs pa dag brdung zhing 'bud do/ /gar thabs kyi sil snyan de dag las kyang kye ma 'jig 54—11

rten stongs par 'gyur ro zhes bya ba de lta bu'i 1rnam pa brjod na cing gdung gdung skad du dbyangs len to/ /gar thabs kyi sil snyan re re'i mdun du yang me tog dri zhim po sna tshogs rnam par 'tsher dab rnams kyi phye mas rin po che'i skon bu legs par bcos 4pa gzhon sha can dag gis rabakang ba sha stag dang / de ma yin pa'i skon bu mang po blta dzin sdug pa/ gur gum gyi phye mas bkang ba mang po 7sha stag thogs so/ /de dag gi mdun du yang bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi na'akhor dang bcas pa khyab par 'gyur ba'i zhal zas dag khyer zhing 'dong ngo / /zhal zas de dag kyang bud shing tsan dan dmar po 9nodang / a ga ru dang / thang shing gi me chung ngus btsos pa dang / gang gā'i klung gi chus btsos pa sha stag ste/ skyur ba dang / lan tshwa'i ro dang / mngar 1 ba dang /bska 1 ba dang / tsha ba dang / kha ba'i ro dang ldan pa/ mdangs skyed pa/phan par 'gyur ba 12sha stag go/ /sā la zung gi drung gi nyen kor thams cad kyang gser gyi bye ma 'jam pos bdal 1 te/ ga pu sha'i ras khridang / snam bu dang /btsos snam dang / dre'u rngog dang / ka ling ma'i ras dang / zab dar 'jam zhing mdog dkar ba rnams kyang bting ngo / /grub pa'i gnas de'i gzhi dpag tshad sum cu rtsa gnyis kho ra khor yug kyang gur gum gyis byugs so/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa'i seng ge'i khri chen po gser las byas pa/ rin po che sna bdun gyis spras shing snang bar byas pa/ ri rab ltar che zhing 'phang mtho ba dag kyang bshams so/ /g.yogs ma yang de dag gi rkyen du 'tsham pa sha stag gis g.yogs te/ gser gyi dril bu g.yer ka sgra si 15li li dang /khrol shang 14gi sgra 'byung ba'i dra ba can 1 gyi yol ba rnams kyis ni bskor/ rgya 54—12

dar spu sdug yug khyim chen po'i bla re rnams ni bres/ gdugs dkar po rnams kyis ni nyi mtshan 1bsgribs/ rnga yab dkar po rnams kyis ni g.yabs/ rgyab rten glang po che'i mche ba la chu srin ma ka ra rten 2pa'i kha nas/ zla ba nya ba'i 'od zer ltar dkar ba'i mu tig gi chun po 'byung zhing spyangs dpa dang ldan pa rnams ni bcas/ sa phyogs rnams ni me tog dri zhim po'i sil mas gtor to/ /dge bsnyen cade dag re re nas kyang 'di snyam du sems te/ bdag gis sems can thams cad la zas 'dod pa rnams la ni zas sbyin no/ /skom 'dod pa rnams la ni skom sbyin no/ /mgo bo dang mig la sogs pa yan lag dang nying lag thams cad 'dod pa rnams la yang ji ltar 'dod pa bzhin du sbyin no/ /dbul po dang / bkren pa dang / phongs 5pa rnams la yang 'dod pa dang / dug dang ske/ gnod pa dang / ma brtags pa'i sbyin pa rnams ma gtogs par gang dang gang dag ci dang ci 'dod pa de dang 0de dag chog par sbyar ro snyam du sems kyi/ gzhan ni ci yang mi sems so/ /de bzhin du dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyi sde tshan/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa la gnas pa de dag thams cad kyis bsams snye pa/ de bzhin gshegs pa la bdag gis bshos nagasol te yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa la bdag gis bshos gsol te yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar bya'o snyam ste/ so so nas de 'ba' zhig 9snying la sem/sa shing yan lag thams cad kyi ba spu rgya skyegs kyi shing gi me tog ltar rtsa dmar ba ni langs/ mig ni mchi ma khrag lta bus gang ste/mchog tu sdug bsngal ba'i tshor ba dang ldan nas/ rang rang gi mchod pa'i yo byad bud shing dang / yam sreg 10shing dang / shing rta dang / rgyal mtshan dang /54—13

gdugs dang / ba dan rnams dang chas te zhal zas kyi mchog gis sbyar 1ba'i snod rnams thogs nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba 2der dong ste lhags nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi 3zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la spos dang/ me tog phreng cadang / phye ma dang / phye ma zhib bu dang / gdugs dang ske/ rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / bla re rgya 5chen po dag gis mchod nas lan 'bum bskor ba byas te/ mig nas mchi ma rgyun mi chad 6par char bzhin du phab nas/ bdag nyid la sdug bsngal gyi rnam pa mang po byed cing /kye ma 'jig rten stongs par 'gyur ro/ /kye ma 'jig rten stongs par 'gyur ro zhes de skad du skad po che 'don te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhabs drung na srog chags shi shu ma ra bzhin du 'gre ldog cing gsol ba 'debs te/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun gyi 'khor dang bcas pas bdag gis sbyar ba'i bshos gsol bar ci gnang / bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du sbyin pa'i tha ma de bzhin gshegs pas bzhes su gsol/zhes gsol ba 'debs so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen bzhin du cang mi gsung bar gyur to / /de dag gis lan gnyis lan gsum du de skad ces gsol kyang / lan gnyis lan gsum du bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /de nas dge bsnyen gyi tshogs de dag re thag chad de cang mi zer bar 'khod nas/ bu gcig pa shi nas dur khrod du bor ma thag pa'i pha ma 'gre ldog pa bzhin du shin tu sdug bsngal bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du dge bsnyen de dag thams cad mchog tu sdug bsngal bar gyur pa las langs te/ rang rang gi mchod pa'i yo byad rnams bsdus nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang 54—14

de'i tshe bslab pa'i gzhi lnga blangs shing / tshul khrims dang / cho ga dang /yon tan dang ldan pa dang / dam pa'i chos kyi gces pa 'dzin pa'i dge bsnyen ma tshong dpon gyi bu mo 'tsho ba'i dpal la sogs pa dge bsnyen ma gang gā'i klung gsum gyi bye ma snyed thams cad kyang bud med kyi gzugs kyis sems can bye ba phrag mang po nges par sgrol ba/ khyim gyi gnas la smod pa sha stag ste/ lus 'di ni nyes pa'i khams brgyad cu rtsa bzhi las lhags 1pas bsdus pa'o/ /lus 'di ni srin bu'i rigs bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi'i zas so/ /lus 'di ni rgyal po'i khri mon 2du brubs pa'i dri 3mnam pa'o/ /lus 'di ni khyi ro rul pa'i dri bam gyis lhag lapar sbags pa'o/ /lus 'di ni sgo dgu nas mi gtsang ba 'dzag ci pa'o / /lus 'di ni sha dang / chu ba dang / rus pa dang / khrag dang /pags 6pa'i zhal zhal can/ rkang lag gi phyi sgo dang / ra ba dang / ba gam can ske/ mig gi skar khung can/ mgo bo'i yang tog can/ yid rgyal po lta bu'i pho brang grong khyer lta bu'o/ /lus 'di ni mkhas pa thams cad kyis spangs shing byis pa'i skye bo dga' bar byed pa'i 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang /gti mug la sogs pa'i nyon mongs pa bye ba snyed kyi srin po 8brten pa/ 'dam bu dang / e raṇ+ḍa / dang / dbu ba dang / chu shing lta bur snying po med pa/glog dang / ri gzar po'i 'bab chu'i dba' rlabs ltar shin tu mi brtan 0pa'ol/ /sgyu ma dang / smig rgyu dang / brag ca dang / zla ba'i gzugs brnyan ltar slu bar byed pa/ rlung shugs drag pos rnam par dkrugs pa'i chu'i shugs kyis brkos pa'i 'gram gyi sdong po ltar g.yang sa na 'dug pa'i chos can/ spyang ki dang / wa dang / bya rgod dang / bya rog rnams kyi zas yin na/ su zhig 54—/5

'di lta bu 'chang ba la dga' bar byed/ rgya mtsho'i chu thams cad skra'i rtse mos blangs te/ ba lang gi mig 1rjes su blugs par ni nus srid kyi/ lus nad bzhi brgya 2rtsa bzhis gzir ba 'di snying po med pa'am/ mi gtsang ba ni tshig tsam gyis bstan par mi nus so/ /sa chen po 'di rgya shug gi 'bras bu'i rus pa'i 'bru tsam sha stag tu byas pa'am/ yungs 'bru tsam 'am / rdul phra rab kyi rdul tsam sha stag tu byas pas ni zad par 'gyur yang srid kyi/ lus 'di yod kyi bar du 'di'i nyes dmigs ni mthar thug par mi 'gyur te/ de bas na dam pa'i chos bsrung ba'i phyir 'di mchil ma bzhin du dor bar bya'o snyam ste/ 'di ltar dge bsnyen ma de dag thams cad chen po stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang ske/ smon pa med pa bsgoms pas 5sems bsgoms pa sha stag ste/ 'di lta ste/dge bsnyen ma 'tsho ba'i dpal zhes bya ba dang / dge bsnyen ma dpal phreng zhes bya ba dang / dge bsnyen ma sa ga zhes bya ba dang / de la sogs pa thams cad kyang theg pa chen po thos par 'dod la/ thos nas kyang gzhan dag la bstan par bya'o snyam du dam bcas pa/ bsrung 6ba lhur len pa/ bud med kyi lus ngan no snyam du smod pa dang / lus snying po med do snyam du smod pa so so nas shas cher sgom 7pa dang / 'khor ba'i 'khor lo gzhig go snyam du sems pa sha stag dang ske/ theg pa chen pos skom la ngoms nas kyang gzhan skom pa dag ngoms 9par bya'o snyam du dam bcas pa sha stag dang / theg pa chen po la sred 1 pa/theg pa chen po la ser sna med pa/ 'jig rten thams cad dang 'thun par slob par 'dod pa dang / grol nas gzhan dgrol bar bya'o/ /rgal nas gzhan bsgral bar bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad 11par bya'o/ /chos 54wa 16

kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya'o snyam du slob par 'dod pa sha stag dang / go cha chen po bgos pa/ bslab pa rnams la brtul zhugs 1brtan pa dang / de bzhin du yon tan du ma dang ldan pa dang / bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du sems can thams cad la snying rje dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ de dag kyang nyi ma 'char kur rashin tu rings par gcig la gcig 'jus te/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i phyir/ yam sreg shing dge bsnyen pha rnams kyi nyis 'gyur khyer ba las bcom ldan 'das kyisang zhal zas ma bzhes nas/ bu shi ba bzhin du mchog tu sdug bsngal bar gyur te/ ngus nas langs te phyogs gcig tu 'khod dom/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lid tsa bī 5gzhon nu gtsang ma dri ma med pa'i snying po la sogs pa yangs pa can na gnas pa'i lid tsa bī 6gzhon nu grong khyer gyi nang na gnas pa dang / phyi rol na gnas pa dang bcas pa rnams dang / 'dzam bu'i 7gling na gnas pa'i rgyal phran 8blon po dang bcas pa gang gā'i klung bzhi'i bye ma snyed thams cad kyang dam pa'i chos bsrung slob la mkhas pa/ tshul khrims dang cho ga dang yon tan dang ldan pa/ dam pa'i chos sun 'byin cing rtags can 'chal pa rnams kyi ser ba lta bur gyur pa sha stag la/ de dag thams cad kyang 'di lta bur 'dod de/ bdag cag gi nor dang / 'bru'i tshogs dang /mdzod dang / bang ba'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag thams cad ni bdud rtsi mi zad par bya ba dang / bdud rtsi gnas par bya ba'i phyir yin gyis / bdag cag gis dam pa'i chos la nan tan bya'o/ /dam pa'i chos la sun 'byin cing log par lta ba rnams kyi lce gcad 2par bya'o zhes legs par dam bcas pa/tshul khrims 'chal pa 5tshul khrims la mi gnas pa rnams ni gos dkar po gyon du 54—17

bcug ste/ khyim pa'i las byed du gzhug go snyam du sems brtul ba/ dam pa'i chos stug 1pa la ni bla ma bzhin du rim gro bya'o snyam du dam bcas pa/ dge 'dun la phan pa dang bde bar gnas par bya ba'i yongs su rdzogs par byas kyang /des chog go snyam du sems pa dang / theg pa chen po thos par 'dod la/ thos nas kyang gzhan dag la bstan par bya'o snyam du yi dam bcas pa la brtan pa dang ske/ de la sogs pa'i yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa nasha stag ste/'di lta ste/ lid tsa bī gzhon nu gtsang ma cadri ma med pa'i 5snying po zhes bya ba dang ske/ sgrib 6pa dag pa zhes bya ba dang / gang gā'i 7chu dri ma med pas byin pa zhes bya ba dang / de la sogs pa yid tsa bī nagazhon nu de dag kyang gcig la gcig 'jus te/ re res kyang gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i bud shing thang shing 9gi mchog dang / tsan dan dang / a ga ru rnams dang / yam sreg 1 shing bye ba phrag brgyad cu rtsa bzhi dang / mchod pa snga 11ma'i nyis 'gyur 12rnams khyer nas mchod pa rnams bsgrags 1 te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong ngo / / lid tsa bī 1 gzhon nu re re la 15yang glang po che brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / rta brgyad khri bzhi stong dang / shing rta brgyad khri bzhi stong dang 1 ‘/ nor bu chu shel brgyad khri bzhi stong dang chas so/ /1 glang po che re re'i mdun du yang / che ba la 'os pa'i gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / dar gyi bla re chen po rnams thogs so/ /gdugs rnams kyi nang na thung ngu gang yin pa de la yang /kho ra khor yug tu dpag tshad gcig yod do/ /dar gyi bla re chen po rnams kyi nang na chung ngu gang yin pa de la yang chu zheng du dpag tshad sum cu rtsa gnyis yod do / /rgyal mtshan rnams kyi nang na thung ngu gang yin pa de la yang 'phang du dpag 51—18

tshad brgya 1yod do/ /ba dan rnams kyi nang na thung ngu gang yin pa des kyang dpag tshad stong du phyin to2/ /de ltar de dag mchod pa rnams dang bcas te bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ zhal zas phul ba las bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung ste/ ma bzhes nas mchog tu sdug bsngal bar gyur te/ re thag chad nas langs te bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus ta la bdun gyi srid tsam du 'phags te 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe 'dzam bu gling pa'i blon po dang / tshong dpon dang / khyim bdag gang ga'i klung 5lnga'i bye ma snyed thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la dad pa/tshul khrims dang / cho ga dang / yon tan rnam par dag pa dang ldan pa/dam pa'i chos sun 'byin pa rnams kyi ser ba lta bur gyur pa sha stag ste/ 'di lta ste / khyim bdag gi rgyal po rnam par snang byed ces bya ba dang / 'gro ba skyong zhes bya ba dang / chos skyong zhes bya ba dang / de la sogs pa dag kyang de'i tshe der lhags te/ de dag thams cad kyis kyang rang rang gi mchod pas mchod pa snga ma rnams zil gyis mnan nas/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa chen po'i tshogs kyis mchod nas zhal zas ma bzhes pa'i phyir/ mchog tu sdug bsngal bar gyur te/ re thag chad nas langs te bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus ta la bdun gyi srid tsam du 'phags te 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra ma gtogs par yangs pa can gyi rgyal po zla ba dri ma 4med pa'i snying po grong khyer gyi nang na gnas pa dang / phyi rol na gnas pa'i g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa la sogs pa 'dzam bu gling thams cad kyi grong khyer dang / ri khrod kyi grong dang /yul po che dang / kha lungs kyi rgyal po gang gā'i klung drug gi bye ma snyed dang lhan 54—19

cig 1tu dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas te lhags so/ /rgyal po de rnams re re la yang dmag 'khrug nas ya phrag bcwa brgyad bcwas brgyad yod do/ /de dag la glang po che rtag tu 'gram pa nas rngul 'dzag pa dag dang / rta rlung gi shugs pas lhag par mgyogs pa dag kyang yod do/ /de dag gi mchod pa'i yo byad gang yin pa de dag kyang mchod pa'i yo byad snga ma de dag las nyis 'gyur cagyis ches bzang la ches mang ste/ de lta bu'i mchod pa'i phul dag khyer nas/dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi dang bcas te lhags so/ /de dag gi mchod pa de rnams kyi nang na gdugs thung ngu gang yin pa de yang dpag tshad brgyad cu chu 5zheng gab par 'dug go/ /ba dan gyi nang na chung ngu gang yin pas kyang dpag tshad brgya 6stong du phyin to7/ /rgyal mtshan phal pa gang yin pa de la yang 'phang du dpag tshad sum cu yod do/ /de ltar yangs pa can gyi rgyal po zla ba dri ma med pa'i snying po dang / nyi 'od ces bya ba dang / de la sogs pa rgyal po rnams nyi ma 'char kur lhags te/ de dag kyang dam pa'i chos sun 'byin cing rtags can 'chal pa rnams kyi ser ba lta bur gyur pa/ mthus kyang sems can rnams dam pa'i chos la 'god par byed pa dang / bdag cag gi nor dang / 'bru'i tshogs dang 8/ mdzod dang / bang ba'i tshogs gang yin pa de dag ni dam pa'i chos gnas par bya ba'i phyir ro snyam du sems pa sha stag dang / bdag cag gis dam pa'i chos la nan tan bya'o/ /dam pa'i chos sun 'byin pa rnams kyi lce ni drung nas gcad 9do zhes dam bcas pa brtan 1 por byas pa sha stag dang / theg pa chen po 'dod pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad la snying brtse ba sha stag ste/de dag gi mchod pa rnams kyis yangs pa can nas grong khyer ku shi'i bar thams 54—20

cad kun tu gang bar gyur to/ /de dag gi gdugs kyi grib ma (radab chags su 'dug pas ni nyi ma'i 'od kyis mi phog go/ /de dag gi kha zas kyi dri bsung gis ni dpag tshad bzhir khyab par gyur te1/ de dag gis bcom ldan 'das la rang rang gis sbyar ba'i zhal zas bzhes par lan gsum gyi bar du gsol ba btab kyang ske/ zhal zas ma bzhes nas yid mi dga' ste/ langs nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe rgyal po ma skyes dgra'i btsun mo ma gtogs par yangs pa can gyi rgyal po'i btsun mo 'jig rten gsum na namadzes ma la sogs pa 'dzam bu gling pa'i rgyal po dang / tshong dpon dang 4/ khyim bdag rnams kyi chung ma gang gā'i klung bdun gyi bye ma snyed dang lhan cig 5tu lhags te/ de dag thams cad kyang bud med kyi gzugs kyis sems can mang po nges par sgrol ba/rtag tu lus bsgom 6pa dang ldan pa/ chen po stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa med pas sems rnam par dag pa sha stag ste/ 'di lta ste/yangs pa can gyi rgyal po'i btsun mo 'jig rten gsum na mdzes ma zhes bya ba dang ske/ btsun mo pri yang ku 7zhes bya ba dang / de la sogs pa thams cad kyang sems can thams cad la bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du snying rje dang ldan pa sha stag ste/ gcig la gcig 'jus nanas/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i phyir/ yam sreg 9shing rnams khyer te/ mchod pa snga ma thams cad rang rang gi mchod pa rnams kyis zil gyis mnan nas/ bcom ldan 'das la nyis 'gyur 10du mchod pa byas te/ de dag gi mchod pa'i yo byad rnams kyi rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / gdugs rnams kyi 'phang dang chu zheng gi tshad kyang snga ma'i nyis 'gyur bas lhag 1 go/ /kha zas rnams kyi dri bsung 2ni 54—21

dpag tshad brgyad du khyab par gyur te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba btab kyang zhal zas ma bzhes nas/ bcom ldan 'das la skor 1ba byed cing skra 'bal la rang rang gi rgyan rnams 'thor 2zhing /skad mi snyan pas ngus te 3bu gcig pa shi ba bzhin du mchog tu sdug bsngal bar gyur nas bcom ldan 'das kyi mthus sā la zung gi drung nyid du phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lha mig yangs zhes bya ba la sogs pa lha'i tshogs gang gā'i klung brgyad kyi bye ma snyed dang lhan cig 4tu lhags nas/ lha de dag gis 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag ltos/ grogs po dag ltos/ mi rnams kyi mchod pa'i yo ci byad mchog tu khyad par du 'phags la/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la mchod pa bkur sti thams cad tshomachod par 'dod de/ mi rnams kyi zhal zas kyi tha ma bzhes pa'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba 'debs kyis / grogs po dag bdag cag gis kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la so so nas mchod pa bya zhing tha ma'i dus su zhal zas dbul bar bya na/ ji ltar bdag cag gis phul ba'i zhal zas de bzhin gshegs pas gsol te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar de bzhin gshegs pas mdzad cig 2gu/ grogs po dag sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni shin tu dkon no/ /de bas kyang zhal zas kyi tha ma'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa phun sum tshogs pa ni ches dkon no/ /kye ma bcom ldan 'das yongs su mya ngan las 'das na ni 'jig rten stongs par 'gyur ro zhes smras so/ /lha de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po thos par 'dod la/ thos nas kyang gzhan dag la bstan to snyam du dam 54—22

bcas pa/ theg pa chen pos skom pa 1ngoms nas kyang gzhan skom pa rnams ngoms napar bya'o snyam du dam bcas pa/ theg pa chen po la sred pa/ theg pa chen po la ser sna med par/ theg pa chen po la phrag dog dang / dus che ba dang ske/ 'chab pa dang / sgyu med pa/ theg pa chen po sun 'byin pa'i sems can rnams kyi ser ba lta bur gyur pa/ dam pa'i chos bsrung caba'i tshul khrims blangs pa/ 'jig rten dang 'thun par slob par 'dod pa/ bdag cag rgal nas gzhan bsgral bar bya'o/ /bdag cag grol nas gzhan dgrol bar bya'o/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bya'o/ /dkon mchog gsum gyi gdung mi 'chad par bya'o snyam du slob par 'dod pa/ go cha chen po bgos pa/ bslab pa rnams la dam bcas pa brtan pa dang / de bzhin du yon tan dpag tu med pa dang ldan pa / bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du 'jig rten thams cad la snying rjes lta ba sha stag ste/ de dag kyang nyi ma 'char kur ston pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i phyir/ bud shing dang / yam sreg 5shing rnams khyer te/ de dag kyang snga mas phul ba'i yam sreg neshing gi nyis 'gyur snye bas bzang ba'i lha rdzas dri bsung nadang ldan pa/ yid du 'ong ba/ mi la dkon pa sha stag go/ /shing rta yang rta'i mchog mgyogs pa dag dang sbyar ba/ dar la dkar pos g.yogs pa/ gzugs dang dbyibs ri mo brir yang mi nus pa/dril bu g.yer ma'i dra ba can gyi yol bas bskor ba/ dar yug khyim chen po'i bla re rgya chen po rtsa ba ri mo can dag la btsugs pa dang / gar thabs dang /rol mo yid du 'ong ba rnams kyis mdun du drangs pa/ kha zas zhim po mang po dag dang / seng ge'i 9khri be+e dūr+ya'i rgyab rten rtse mo nor bu'i 'od kyis snang bar 54—23

byas pa/ zhabs rten gser las byas pa dag kyang bshams pa dang / sa phyogs kyang me tog dri bsung 1zhim po sna tshogs kyis mdzes par byas pa/ me tog gi sil ma bkram 2zhing bkod pa/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi phyi bzhin 'brang ba sha stag ste/ so so nas mchi ma khrag lta bu mi thub cing mchog tu sdug bsngal bas gdungs nas/ sems can thams cad la phan pa dang / bde ba dang /snying brtse dba'i phyir dang / gdul bar bya ba'i dbang gi don du theg pa chen po'i mchog tu gsang ba/ stong pa nyid kyi rnam pa dgongs pa'i tshig rnam pa sna tshogs kyi chos kyi sgo'i tshul bshad par bya ba'i phyir/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ mchod pa dang bkur sti'i mchog rnam pa mang po dag byas te bskor ba yang byas nas/bcom ldan 'das kyi 'khor rnams kyi phyir rang rang gi bla gos sa la bting ste/rang rang gi rgyan rnams phog cing gtor nas rang rang gi skra 'bal cing skad mi snyan pas ngu ste/ bcom ldan 'das la tshig 'thun par 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gis sbyar ba'i bshos gsol te/ yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar mdzad du gsol/ zhes lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba btab kyang bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bzhes te cang mi gsung nas/ de dag re thag chad de langs nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe klu'i rgyal po phyogs bzhi na gnas pa paklu'i rgyal po nor rgyas kyi bu dang dga' bo dang nye dga' bo la sogs pa klu'i rgyal po gang gā'i klung dgu'i bye ma snyed shin tu rings par nyi ma 'char kur lha rnams kyi mchod pa las kyang nyis 'gyur bas 5lhag pa'i mchod pa'i yo byad rang rang gi 'byor pa dang 'tsham pa dag khyer nas/ bcom 54—24

ldan 'das kyi thad du dong ste phyag 'tshal nas/ zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba btab kyang bsam pa bzhin du ma grub nas langs te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe rnam thos kyi bu la sogs pa gnod sbyin gyi bdag po g.yog 'khor dang bcas pa/ gang gā'i klung bcu'i bye ma snyed gcig la gcig 'jus nas / rang rang gi mchod pa rnams kyis klu'i rgyal po rnams kyi mchod pa snga ma zil gyis mnan nas/ tshogs chen po dang chas te lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba btab kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyis zhal zas ma bzhes nas yid mi dga' ste langs nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe nam mkha' lding gi rgyal 1po dgra'i mdza' 5bo zhes bya ba la sogs pa nam mkha' lding gi rgyal po gang gā'i klung nyi shu'i bye ma snyed kyis/ rang rang gi mchod pas gnod sbyin gyi rgyal po snga ma dag gi mchod pa rnams zil gyis mnan nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba btab kyang zhal zas ma bzhes nas/ yid mi dga' ste langs nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe dri za'i bdag po mis byin gyi bu la sogs pa dri za'i bdag po gang gā'i klung sum cu'i bye ma snyed kyis mchod pa snga ma thams cad pas kyang ches mchog tu gyur pa'i mchod pa rnams khyer te 'ongs nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa la mchod pa byas te/ rol mo snyan dgu 4byas nas phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba btab kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bzhes nas/ de dag kyang yid mi dga' bar gyur te/ langs nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe mi'am ci'i bdag po legs mthong la sogs pa mi'am ci'i bdag po 54—25

gang gā'i klung bzhi bcu'i bye ma snyed lhags te/ snga ma rnams kyi mchod pa de dag bsdoms pa bas kyang de dag re re'i mchod pa ches khyad par 'phags par gyur te/de dag kyang zhal zas ma bzhes nas/ yid mi dga' bar gyur te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lto 'phye chen po'i bdag po legs mthong chen po la sogs pa lto 'phye chen po'i bdag po gang gā'i klung lnga bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis mchod pa snga ma'i nyis 'gyur 1khyer ba las/ snga ma bzhin du zhal zas ma bzhes nas / yid mi dga' ste phyogs gcig tu na'akhod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lha ma yin gyi bdag po bde mchog rigs la sogs pa lha ma yin gyi bdag po gang gā'i klung drug cu'i bye ma snyed lus che zhing snang ba chen po dang ldan pa/ lha ma yin gyi bsam pa med pa sha stag gis/ mchod pa snga ma'i nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur 3gyi mchod pa dag khyer te 'ongs te/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas/ zhal zas ma bzhes te yid mi dga' bar gyur nas/ langs te shing sā la zung gi drung du rang rang gi gzi byin gyis snang bar byas te 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe sbyin byed ma'i bu'i bdag po gang gā'i chu dri ma med pa rjes byin la sogs pa sbyin byed ma'i bu gang gā'i klung bdun cu'i bye ma snyed lus che zhing snang ba chen po dang ldan pa/ sbyin byed ma'i bu'i bsam pa med pa sha stag gis mchod pa snga ma thams cad las mchod pa nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur bas cabazang ba dag khyer ba las/ snga ma bzhin du zhal zas ma bzhes nas yid mi dga' bar gyur te/ shing sā la zung gi bar gdu rang rang gi gzi brjid kyis snang bar byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe srin po'i bdag po 'jigs byed la sogs pa srin po'i bdag tshopo gang gā'i klung brgyad cu'i bye ma snyed srin po'i bsam pa med 51—26

pa sha stag gis gzi brjid chen po'i tshogs kyis sā la zung gi drung du snang bar byas nas1/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe 'bras bu'i shing gi bdag po dri srel nal sogs pa 'bras bu'i shing gi bdag po gang gā'i klung dgu bcu'i bye ma snyed kyis snga ma'i mchod pa thams cad pas nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur gyis 3lhag pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs khyer nas/khu byug pho rgyags pa rnams dang / bung ba rnams skad 'byin pa dang ldan pa'i me tog 'tsher ba'i 'khri shing mang po'i dog pa dang / lo ma kha 'bus pa rnams kyis sa phyogs brgyan te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po sgyu 'phrul chen po la sogs pa rig sngags 'chang gi rgyal po gang gā'i klung stong gi bye ma snyed kyis mchod pa snga ma'i nyis 'gyur bas 4lhag pa'i mchod pa dag khyer nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lha mo 'dod dgur 5sgyur ba'i gzugs can legs mthong ma la sogs pa gang gā'i klung bye ba'i 6bye ma snyed kyis yangs pa can gyi rgyal po'i btsun mo'i mchod pa sna nyis 'gyur bas 8lhag pa dag khyer te/ rang rang gi rgyan rnams bcom ldan 'das kyi spyan sngar sa la spungs nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lha'i bu mo ram bha dang / urba shi la sogs pa lha'i bu mo gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag brgya'i bye ma snyed mchod pa snga ma'i nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur bas 9ches lhag par mang zhing spa ba dag gis mdun du drangs te/ snga ma bzhin du phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe 'byung po'i tshogs pa ba sangs ltar 'khor ba zhes bya ba la sogs pa gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag stong gi bye ma snyed snga ma bzhin du phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe 'jig rten skyong ba bzhi'i 0lha'i 54wa 27

bu gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag 'bum dang lhan cig tu mchod pa snga ma'i nyis 'gyur nyis 'gyur bas 1lhag pa dag khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba btab kyang / bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bzhes nas / snga ma bzhin du phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe rlung lha bzhi rlung gtong ba'i lha gang gā'i klung bye ba phrag 'bum dang lhan cig 2tu dus ma yin par yang shing ljon pa dang / 'khri shing dang / shing gel pa dang /nags ma rnams dang / snye ma dang / me tog gi 'khri shing dang / byi ru rnams kyis sa phyogs rgyan par byed cing / dus tshigs /thams cad kyi me tog gi dpal rnams phyogs su rgyas par byed la/ lo ma kha 'bus pa/ rtsa 6ba dmar ba rnams kyis shing sā la zung nyi ma 'char ga'i 'od zer ser po ja hong 7khar 'dug pa bzhin du byas nas/ mchod pa snga ma'i nyis 'gyur bas 8lhag pa'i mchod pa dag khyer te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas/ snga ma bzhin du shing sā la zung gi drung du 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe char pa 'bebs pa'i lha gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed sprin chen po dang / chu skyar rnams phyi bzhin 'brang zhing glog 'gyu ba'i gseb nas rma bya'i mgrin pa ltar mdog sngo ba'i char gyi rgyun 'bab la/ 'brug sgra dal nas sgrogs 9pa'i sprin dang ldan pas char zim bu bsil ba dang 'dres pa'i me tog gi char 'bebs shing / bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ zhal zas ma bzhes nas re thag chad de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i gdung zhugs la bzhen pa'i me bsad 1 pa'i phyir nam mkha' nyid la 'khod do / /gzhan yang de'i tshe spos kyi glang po sgra gcan dang / lung tang mdog dang /sbrang rtsi mdog sel dang / 'dod dgu'i 1 spos ldan la sogs pa spos kyi glang po 54wa 28

gang gā'i 1rlung nyi shu'i bye ma snyed theg pa chen po 'dod pa sha stag gis ston pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i naphyir gangs kyi sman dang / pad+ma'i rtsa ba dang /sdong bu shing rta chen po'i 'phang lo tsam sha stag dang / dgon pa chen po dag nas pad+ma dang / ud pa la dang / ku mu das dang / pad+ma dkar po dang / rtsa ba dang ske/ 'bras bu dang / rdo gu 4tha dad pa du ma dag sna'i thor tos phyung zhing phyung zhing khyer te/ rlung gi shugs pas kyang ches mgyogs pa dang / shin tu rings par dbyar gyi 'brug sgra bzhin du sgrogs shing 5lhags nas/ pad+ma'i 'dab 6ma bcer ba'i seng ge'i khri'i 7lda ldi dag bshams te/ bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa byas nas/ zhal zas ma bzhes nas re thag chad de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe seng ge 8seng ge'i sgra sgrogs 9pa zhes bya ba la sogs pa seng ge gang gā'i klung sum cu'i bye ma snyed sems can thams cad la mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa sha stag gis/ seng ge'i rtsal chen pos spos kyi glang po che rnams dang 'dra bar me tog dang 'bras bu rnams khyer te/ rings par lhagasari nas phyogs gcig 1 tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe bya ngang pa dang /khrung khrung dang / ngur pa dang / ka dam pa dang / zal mo dang / bzhad ridang / khu byug dang / ba li ka dang / ka la ping ka dang / shang shang te'u la sogs pas kyang spos kyi glang po che rnams dang 'dra bar me tog dang 'bras bu khyer te / rang rang gi skad phyung 1 nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe sa'i steng na ba dang / ma he mo dang / ra ma mo yod do cog gis kyang 5nu ma 'o mas bkang ste/ shin tu rings par lhags nas/ shing sā la zung gi drung nas phyogs gshong zhig mthong nas/ der rang rang gi nu ma 'o mas gang ba de 54wa 29

dag las 'o ma gseg ma dang / bye ma dang / ba tshas ma 'bags 1shing tsha ba'i skyon du 'gyur ba med pa dag gzags 2te/ 'o ma de dag gi nang nas sbrang bu dag bsal nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe drang srong bzod par smra ba la sogs pa gling bzhi na gnas pa'i drang srong mngon par shes pa lnga dang ldan pa/ theg pa chen po 'dod pa sha stag la/ gang gā'i klung dkrigs kyi bye ma snyed rang rang gi rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs kyis yam sreg shing dang / zhal zas dag khyer nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do / /gzhan yang de'i tshe 'od srung chen po la sogs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun kha cig dang / gnas brtan kun dga' bo la sogs pa ma gtogs par yul phyogs na gnas pa'i dge slong dang / dge slong ma ji snyed yod pa de dag thams cad kyang ma lus par der lhags so/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe ri rab la sogs pa ri chen po rnams dang / 'jig rten gyi bar mtshams kyi ri gang gā'i klung grangs med pa'i bye ma snyed kyang shing ljon pa dang / 'khri shing mang po nyi tshan 3gyi grib ma byed pa dang / brag zang yag grib ma che ba dang / brag kha nas 'bab pa'i chus 4gang ba dang / sman gshong rdo gu dang / rtsa ba dang / 'bras bus gang ba dag kyang der lhags so/ /lha'i bu mthu bo che'i 'dun ma chen po dag kyang ri rab dang bcas te mchod pa'i phyir lhags nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lha'i bu mthu bo che 'od chen po rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i nang na gnas pa dang / chu klung chen po dag gi nang na gnas pa gang gā'i klung grangasari med nga /'i bye ma snyed mchod pa snga ci ma bas ches sgyu nyis 'gyur 0 gyis mdzes pa'i ma/chod nga/ sngon du btang nas/ nyi ma'i 'od kyis ma ra 54—30

me'i 'od zil gyis mnan pa bzhin du rang rang gi 'od kyis nyi ma'i 'od zil gyis mnan te/ nyi ma 'char ma'i 'od kyis shing mya ngan 'tshang gi lo ma thams cad dmar lam mer snang bar byed pa/ de bzhin du rang rang gi 'od kyis chu klung gser ldan gyi chu dmar lam mer snang bar byas nas/ bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal te/ phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe grong khyer ku shi nas shing sā la zung gi drung gi bar skabs kyi bar snang la khang bzangs 1ri'i dbang po'i rtse mo lta bu/ ngang pa'i thal gong ltar dkar ba sha stag gis 'khrigs par gyur to/ /sa gzhi ni skyed mos 2tshal dang / rdzing bu'i chu pad mas mdzes par byas pa dag gis gang bar 'dug ste/ byang gi sgra mi snyan gyi skyed dmos tshal bas kyang lhag par mdzes so/ /gcig tu na dga' ba'i tshal dang / shing rta sna tshogs can dang 'dra bar gyur te/ sa phyogs de dag de ltar dga' dga' ltar 'dug kyang / lha dang / lha ma yin dang / mi de dag de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i phyir shin tu ngu'o/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams rang rang gi 'khor la 'di skad ces zer to4/ /grogs po dag ltos/ grogs po ru dag ltos/ lha dang / lha ma yin dang / mi rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod pa'i las khyad par du 'phags la/ de bzhin gshegs pa la zhal zas kyi tha ma 'bul ba la brtson gyis6/ grogs po dag bdag cag kyang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas la so so nas mchod pa bya'o/ /zhal zas kyi tha ma yang dbul bar bya'o / /gal te bdag cag gis phul ba'i zhal zas kyi tha ma/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhes par gyur na/ de las bdag cag gis sbyin pa'i pha ro pa tu 54—91

phyin pa chen po thob par 'gyur ro zhes de dag gis de skad ces smras nas/g.yog 'khor mang po grangs med pa dang bcas pas mchod pa sngam 1ma'i nyis 'gyur nagyi mchod pa dang zhal zas mang po dag khyer ro/ /me tog mang po dag kyang tsho khyer te / 'di lta ste/ man dā ra ba rnams dang / man dā ra ba chen po rnams dang /ke ke ru ka rnams dang / ke ke ru ka chen po rnams dang / man dzu ṣa du ka rnams dang / man dzu ṣa rika chen po rnams dang / san ta na 56cig rnams dang /san ta na 7ga chen po rnams dang / 'od can rnams dang / 'od can chen po rnams dang / kun tu 'od can rnams dang / 'od mtha' yas pa rnams dang /mdzes sdug rnams dang / mdzes sdug chen po rnams dang / dga' byed rnams dang / dga' byed chen po rnams dang / dri mchog rnams dang / dri mchog chen po rnams dang / spos kyi ngad ldang rnams dang / spos kyi ngad ldang chen po rnams dang / kun tu ngad ldang rnams dang / kun tu ngad ldang chen po rnams dang / mtha' yas ngad ldang rnams dang / mtha' yas ngad ldang chen po rnams dang / lha rdzas kyi 'dab nam rnams dang / klung gi me tog rnams dang / yongs 'du 9 sa brtol 1 rnams dang / de lta bu gzhan dag kyang khyer nas/bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ nyi ma'i gzi byin gyis srin bu me khyer gyi 'od zil gyis mnan pa bzhin du rang rang gi gzi byin gyis thams cad kyi 'od zil gyis mnan te/ zhal zas ma bzhes nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /gzhan yang de'i tshe lha'i dbang po brgya byin sum cu rtsa gsum pa'i lha rnams kyi 'khor dang bcas pas/ mchod pa snga ma de'i nyis 'gyur 11de'i rkyen du 'tsham pa de na yod pa'i me tog gi sna grangs 1 du ma yid du 'ong ba rnams dang / yid du 51—32

'ong ba chen po rnams dang / dri bsung zhim 17po rnams khyer ro/ /khang bzangs tshonachen po rdo thal gyi mdog ltar dkar ba/ them skas kyi rim pa dang ldan pa/ skar khung gi phreng ba du ma phug ron shug rtse ba dang ldan pa dag kyang sprul nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de 5logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud de/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni theg pa chen po'i mdo'i sde tshan srung ba lags na/bdag cag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du bdag cag gis phul ba'i zhal zas bzhes su gsol/ de skad ces gsol kyang zhal zas ma bzhes nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do// //4bam po gnyis pa/ de'i rjes la mthar gyis 'dod pa na spyod pa'i lha'i ris drug po rnams kyis steng gi bar snang la mchod pa dang / 'od snga ma las khyad par du spags rinas/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong ste/ de dag gi mchod pa'i nang na gdugs phal pa gang yin pa de 6 yang kho ra khor yug tu gling bzhi pa'i khyon tsam mo/ /ba dan phal pa gang yin pa de yang rgya mtsho chen po bzhi'i mthar thug ste/ shar phyogs kyi rgya mtsho nas nub phyogs kyi rgya mtshor thug ste / rlung gis bskyod dam/ rlung gis phyar na ba dan de dag las pi bang 7gi sgra snyan pa khong nas 'khyil pa lta bur snyan pa dag 'byung ste/ de dag bcom ldan 'das la phyag 'tshal nas zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba btab kyang / bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung nas 8re thag chad de phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de'i tshe srid pa'i rtse mor skyes pa rnams ma gtogs par gong ma gong ma'i sems 54—33

can gzhan migang yin pa de dag thams cad bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bya ba'i phyir/ mchod pa rgya chen po'i tshogs dang chas te lhags nas snga ma bzhin du phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /mi mjed 5kyi bdag po tshangs pa yang tshangs ris kyi lha'i bu dpag tu med pa dag gis bskor cing dmadun du bdar te/ rang gi gzi byin gyis lha thams cad kyi gzi byin zil gyis mnan nas/ mchod pa'i tshogs chen po dang chas te bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du dong ste/ de dag gi ba dan phal pa gang yin pa de yang tshangs pa'i 'jig rten nas 'phyang ste/ shing sā la zung gi drung du thug go/ /des kyang bcom ldan 'das la zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bzhes nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do//de nas de'i tshe lha ma yin gyi dbang po thags zangs 4ris lha ma yin gyi g.yog 'khor dpag tu med pa dang bcas pas/ tshangs pa dang dbang po gnyis ma gtogs par de'i bar gyi lha yod do cog gi 'od rang gi 'od kyis mog mog por byas nas/ de'i rkyen du 'tsham pa'i mchod pa'i tshogs dang zhi/ rkyen du 'tsham pa'i zhal zas dag dang chas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ngo / /de'i gdugs phal pa yang chu zheng du 'jig rten gyi khams chung ngu khyab pa tsam ste/des kyang bcom ldan 'das la zhal zas bzhes par gsol ba las/ bcom ldan 'das kyis ma bzhes nas langs te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas bdud sdig can chung ma grangs med pa'i 'khor dang chas 8te/ sems can dmya'/ ba thams cad kyi bar sung thams cad phye nas/ de dag la chu dang / kha zas la sogs pa 9ci 'dod pa byin te/ de dag la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dran par gyis shig /sbyin pa'i tha zuku la 51—34

rjes su yi 1rang bar gyis shig ces smras nas/ de dag la khyed bde bar gyur cig ces kyang dbugs phyung ngo / /sems can dmyal ba'i grong khyer mtshon chas gang zhing me chen po 'bar ba rnams su yang sprin chen po bzhin du chu chen po phab nas / sems can dmyal ba pa rnams kyis sngon ma myong ba'i bde ba dang ldan pa'i 'du shes bskyed de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus bdud kyi sems kyi gnas skabs de lta bur gyur to/ /de'i 'khor gang yin pa de dag gis kyang gzhu dang ske/ ral gri dang / tho ba dang / dgra sta dang / rdo rje rtse gcig pa dang /mtshon kum pa na dang / lcags kyi ber ka dang / lcags mda' dang / sha ta ka ni ha dang / mda' dang / 'phang mdung dang / mdung rtse gcig pa la sogs pa mtshon cha rnam pa du ma yongs su spangs te chos lhur len par gyur to/ /de'i mchod pa yang lha snga ma rnams la med pa de lta bur gyur te/ de'i gdugs phal pa'i chu zheng du yang 'jig rten gyi khams bar ma'i khyon tsam mo/ /de ltar de mthu chen po dang ldan zhing rang gi chung ma rnams kyi narnga yab kyis g.yob bzhin du bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der phyin nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ thal mo sbyar nas 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa dang / 'khor dang bcas pas bdag cag gis phul ba'i zhal zas bzhes su gsol/ bcom ldan 'das bdag cag rigis da 4slan chad theg pa chen po'i slad du yi dam bca' bar chi 'tshal te/rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang su yang rung / 'jigs pa'i slad du'am/rnyed pa dang bkur ste 'tshal ba'i slad du'am/ thob tu re ba'i slad du'am/gzhan gyis bgyid du stsal ba'am/ gzhan gyi yid bsrung ba'i slad du yang rung ste/51—35

theg pa chen po rjod 1par bgyid na/ de'i don du 'jigs pa dang / mi dga' ba thams cad bsal ba'i gsang sngags bshad par 'tshal lo/ /tar+ya thā/ jag ke /ṭa ṭa ra jag ke2 /ro ru re/ ma hā ro ru re/ ā la mā la/ tā la/swā hā/ chos smra ba 'khrul pa dang 'jigs pas gnod par gyur pa rnams/ chos kyi tshul la spobs pa bskyed par bgyi ba dang / mu stegs pa rnams myos par bgyi ba dang / dam pa'i chos bsrung ba dang / bdag dang gzhan bsrung ba'i slad du bdag gis rang gi dam tshig gis smras pa'i gsang sngags 'di glang po che'i 'jigs pa'am/ nags khung gi 'jigs pa'am/ chu klung gi 'jigs pa'am/me'i 'jigs 4pa rnams kyi nang du bsrung ba'i gzungs 5sngags kyi don du rjod 6pa gang lags pa de dag ni rjod 7pa tsam gyis ji ltar ru nasbal rang gi lus bsrungs pa 9de bzhin du/ bdag gis g.yo dang sgyu ma mchis par de dag gi 1 'jigs pa thams cad las bsrung bar bgyi/ stobs dang ldan par yang bgyid lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis da zhal zas 'di bzhes par gsol zhes bskul to/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bdud sdig can la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /sdig can khyod kha zas kyi phyir gsol ba ma 'debs shig /gsang sngags kyi tshig 'di 1 sems can thams cad la phan pa'i phyir chos kyi sbyin par 'gyur bas na bzhes par bya'i/ zang zing gi sbyin pa ni de lta ma yin gyis12/sdig can khyod gsol ba ma 'debs shig ces bka' stsal nas/ bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar gyur to/ /lan gnyis lan gsum gyi bar du yang bdud dang bdud kyi bu mo rnams kyis bcom ldan 'das la gsol ba btab pa las ma bzhes te/ re thag chad nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas de'i 54—36

tshe lha'i bu dbang phyug chen po lha'i bu dpag tu med pa mthu dpag tu med pa 1dag gis mdun du bdar te/ rang gi 'od kyis tshangs pa dang / lha'i dbang po dang / lha ma yin dang / bdud kyi 'od rnams snag 5tsha'i gong bu bzhin du 'od mi gsal bar byas te/ bcom ldan 'das kyi mchod pa rgya chen po nyis 'gyur /nyis 'gyur bas calhag pa dag khyer nas der song ste/ de'i mchod pa rnams kyi nang na gdugs pazlo pa gang yin pa de yang chu zheng du stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams khyab par 'dug ste/ mchod pa de lta bu sngon du btang nas/ bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du phyin te/ lan du mar ribaskor ba byas nas zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to / /bcom ldan 'das la bdag mchod pa bgyid pa ni sbrang bu mchod pa bgyid pa dang 'dra ste/ bdag sbrang bu dang 'dra bas bcom ldan 'das la mchod pa bgyid pa'i rngo ga la thogs kyis 6kyang / bcom ldan 'das bdag la thugs brtse ba'i slad du zhal zas kyi tha ma gsol bar ci gnang 75zhes lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol ba btab kyang / lan gnyis nalan gsum du bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar gyur te/ re thag chad nas langs te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de nas de'i tshe sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung grangs med pa gtams phrag dkrigs kyi 9bye ma snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams yid 'phrog sgra snyan mu tug ces bya ba zhig yod de/de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba bzhugs te/ des sras kyi thu 1 bo nyan thos 51—37

lus chen mtha' yas la bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su song la/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba ring po mi thogs par yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur gyis1/ rigs kyi bu khyod kyis de'i don du 'jig rten gyi khams 'di nas zhal zas zhim po phan pa dag khyer te song shig /mchod pa chen po dag kyang khyer te song la/ de la 'di skad du de bzhin gshegs pa bcom ldan 'das kyis 2zhal zas 'di gsol te yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar mdzad du gsol zhes gyis shig /khyod kyi the tshom dang yid gnyis ci dang ci yod pa de dang de dag kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa de kho na la legs par zhus shig dang ske/ des khyod la lung bstan 3par 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal to/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas des/ legs sol/ /legs so zhes gsol nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa de la bskor ba byas nas / zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen po grangs med pas bskor cing mdun du bdar nas/ mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi cakhams 'dir 'ongs so/ /de nas de'i tshe stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di g.yos rab tu g.yos/ 'gul rab tu 'gul/'khrugs rab tu 'khrugs/ 'khor rab tu 'khor/ 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/shig shig rab tu shig shig /mer mer rab tu mer mer/ ldem ldem rab tu ldem ldem mor/ /de la sogs pa byas te/ sa chen po rab tu g.yos so/ /de nas 'khor de dag gi nang na tshangs pa dang / dbang po dang / 'jig rten skyong dang / lha ma yin dang / dbang phyug chen po la sogs pa lha rnams kyis sa 51—38

gzhi de lta bur gyur pa mthong nas skyi bung zhes byas te/ 'jigs shing kha dang lkog ma skams 1nas/ 'bros par chas te rang rang gi 'od kyang mi mthong zhing 'od nyams par gyur to/ /de nas 'khor de nyid kyi nang nas/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa langs te/ lha'i tshogs de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /grogs po dag ma 'jigs shig /ma 'jigs shis /shar phyogs logs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung grangs med pa gtams phrag dkrigs kyi dbye ma'i rdul phra rab grangs med pa snyed 'das pa na/ 'jig rten gyi khams yid 'phrog sgra snyan mu tug ces bya ba zhig yod de/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nam mkha' dang mnyam pa zhes bya ba da ltar bzhugs la 'tsho zhing gzhes 3te/ de bzhin gshegs pa des rang gi sras kyi thu bo nyan thos la bos te bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu khyod mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams su song la/ de na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa zhes bya ba yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur gyisal/ de dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la zhal zas kyi tha ma phul la/ khyod kyi the tshom dang yid gnyis ci dang ci yod pa de dag kyang legs par zhus shig dang / des khyod la lung bstan par 'gyur ro zhes bka' stsal ter/bcom ldan 'das des byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas 6'di btang ste/ byang chub sems dpa' 7grangs med pas bskor cing namadun du bdar nas/ 'dir 'ongs pa de'i gzi brjid kyis khyod kyi 'od nyams par gyur to/ /de 'ong ba la rjes su yi 9rang bar gyis shig /de bzhin gshegs pa nam mkha' dang mnyam pas bdag cag gi de bzhin gshegs pa la 54—39

mchod pa mdzad pa la yang ltos shig ces byas so/ /de nas 'khor de dag thams cad kyis me long gi ngos la bdag gi gzugs mthong ba bzhin du/ 'jig rten gyi khams thag ring po na 1bzhugs pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa de dang / 'jig rten gyi khams de mthong ngo / /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas 'khor de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /ji ltar khyod kyis 'jig rten gyi khams 'di dang ske/ de bzhin gshegs pa 'di mthong ba de bzhin du/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams nadang / 'jig rten gyi khams gzhan dag kyang ltos shig /de bzhin gshegs pa rnams ni 'di ltar bdag nyid che ba yin te/ rang rang gi gnas na bzhugs bzhin du yang khyed la zhal ston par mdzad do/ /'khor de dag gis smras pa/ kye ma de bzhin gshegs pa de ltar bdag nyid che ba yang yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ba lta/ kyi hud ces bla zhing 'khod do / /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa dag gis bskor ba yang mthong ste/ byang chub sems dpa' de'i lus kyi ba spu'i khung bu re re nas pad ma chen po byung ngo / /pad ma chen po re re la yang grong khyer bdun khri brgyad stong bdun khri brgyad stong yod la grong khyer de dag kyang yul yangs pa can gyi thag gru tsam sha stag ste/ rin po che sna bdun gyi ra ba dang 'obs bdun rim gyis bskor la / shing ta la'i phreng ba bdun rim gyis mdzes par byas pa sha stag ste/ 'byor pa dang / rgyas pa dang / bde ba dang ldan zhing dga' dga' ltar 'dug la/ ra ba de dag kyang 'dzam bu chu bo'i gser gyi ba gam chen po sha stag gis bskor te/ ba gam thams cad kyi bar bar na yang shing ljon pa gzhon sha can 'bras bu dang me tog 54wa 40

dang ldan pa sna mang po dag yod do/ /shing ljon pa de dag gi yal ga rlung gis bskyod pa las kyang sil snyan dga' bar byed pa'i sgra snyan cing 1chags su rung ba 'byung nab sna lnga lnga sgrogs te / sgra de dag gis sems can de dag rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur 4spyod do/ /'obs de dag thams cad kyang chu bsil zhing shel bzhin du dang ba dag gis gang bar 'dug ste/ de dag gi nang kho ra khor yug tu sems can de dag rin po che'i gru dag 5gis dga' zhing rgyu bar byed do/ /chu de dag kyang pad ma dang / ud pa la dang / ku mu da shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam sha stag gis brgyan to/ /thobs kyi kho ra khor yug kyang skyed ne mos tshal gyi phreng bas mdzes par byas te/ skyed 7mos tshal re re la yang rdzing bu thag gru dpag tshad phyed pa lnga lnga yod do/ /rdzing bu'i chu de 8dag kyang pad ma dang /ud pa la dang / ku mu da kha dog sna tshogs dri zhim po shing rta'i 'phang lo tsam 9sha stag gis khebs par 'dug la/ shing ljon pa me tog rgyas pa'i phreng bas mdzes par byas so/ /skyed 1 mos tshal kho ra khor yug na yang ngang ngur dang /zal mo dang / khrung khrung shug 1 dag gis pad ma'i ze 'bru myong 12bar byed do/ /kho ra khor yug gi skyed 1 mos tshal de dang de dag na yang khang khyim dag yod la/khang pa re re la yang chu zheng du dpag tshad bzhi bzhi yod de/ rtsig 1 pa ni gser dang ske/ dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel las byas/ sa gzhi 15ni ke ke ru las grub pa ste/ nor bu'i 'jo tshar gyis spel cing 10snang bar byas pa'i mu tig gi do shal spyangs :pa dang ldan pa/ gser gyi rta babs chen po dang / skar khung dang / dra ba dag gis brgyan pa'i khang bzangs 18mthon po sa gzhi ni gser gyi bye ma bdal 19ba dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /rdzing bu rnams kyang 'drul 2 54wa 41

ba'i lam gser gyi them skas them pa bcwa 1brgyad dang ldan pa dang / mtha' thog thag tu gser gyi chu shing gi phreng bas mdzes par byas pa'i lha'i tsan dan gyi dri bsung can gyi chu dang ldan pa sha stag go/ /grong khyer chen po de dag re re'i nang na yang rgyal po brgyad khri bzhi stong brgyad khri bzhi stong yod de/ de dag thams cad kyang bud med kyi tshogs dpag tu med pa dpag tu med pa nadag gis bskor cing / 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga dang ldan te cartse zhing dga' la dga' mgur raspyod do/ /sems can gzhan dag kyang de dang 'dra ste/ sa phyogs ka tsa lin 6da'i gos ltar reg na bde ba/ tsan dan gyi chus chag chag btab pa/ me tog gi sil mas gtor ba/ gzhan dag na rtse zhing dga' la dga' mgur 7spyod do / /grong khyer chen po dag na theg pa chen po'i sgra ma gtogs 8par theg pa gzhan gyi sgra med do/ /pad ma chen po de dag la yang seng ge'i khri chen po rkang pa gser dang / dngul dang / be+e drur+ya dang / shel las byas pa/ ka ling ma'i ras kyis g.yogs pa/ che ba la 'os pa/ 'jig rten gsum na phul du bya ba sha stag gis dkris ‘ te/ seng ge'i khri de dag la rgyal po de dag 'khod cing sems can gzhan dag theg pa chen po'i mdo sde rnams slob par byed de/ rgyal po de dag gi 0mdun na la la ni yi ge 'dri 1/ la la ni klog /la la ni kha ton 12slob bo / /de ltar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas kyi ba spu'i khung bu nas skyes pa'i pad ma dag la 'khod pa'i sems can de dag 'dod pa'i yon tan lnga'i dga' ba dang ldan yang / de dag yongs su spangs nas mya ngan gyis gdungs te smre sngags 'don cing / kyi hud kyi hud ces bla zhing 'khod de/ nyis 'gyur 1 du mchod pa'i tshogs 'bul bar byed do/ /de nas 54—42

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pas bskor te/ de lta bu'i 'byor pa'i rnam pa dag ston cing mchod pa'i tshogs chen po dang / zhal zas ches rgya che ba dag khyer te 'ongs nasam/ zhal zas de dag dang / pad ma de dag gi dri bsung tshor ba gang yin pa de dag kyang nyon mongs pa dang bral bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mthu chen pos 'jig rten gyi khams thams cad kyang mthong bar gyur to/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas kyi lus kyi tshad kyang nam mkha' dang mnyam par 'dug ste1/ sus kyang mthong bar mi nus so/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas bcom ldan 'das kyi thad du song ste/ zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas thal mo sbyar te 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bdag gis phul ba'i zhal zas bcom ldan 'das kyis bzhes su gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar gyur te2/lan gnyis lan gsum du gsol kyang / bcom ldan 'das cang mi gsung bar bzhugs nas byang chub sems dpa' de langs te phyogs gcig tu 'dug go/ /de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs logs nas kyang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lus chen mtha' yas zhes bya ba 'khor gyi tshogs chen po dang ldan pa sha stag lhags te/ de dag gi pad ma dang / grong khyer gyi tshad kyang snga ma snga ma las nyis 'gyur 5nyis 'gyur 6gyis che ba dang /'byor pa nyis 'gyur 7nyis 'gyur nagyis che ba sha stag dang chas te/ de dag der lhags nas bcom ldan 'das la pad ma dag gis mchod pa byas te snga ma bzhin du phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /shing sā la zung gi drung grub pa'i gnas de nyid na 54—443

dkyil 'khor sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi tshad kyi khyon gyi sa gzhi la/ sems can mi 'khod pa'i go 1skabs ci yang med do/ /de na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po de ltar lus che ba rang rang gi g.yog 'khor dag dang bcas pa de rnams kyang / kha cig 5ni sa phyogs smyung bu'i rtse mo'i khyon tsam la 'khod do/ /kha cig ni khab kyi rtse mo'i khyon tsam la 'khod do/ /kha cig ni rdul phra rab kyi khyon tsam la bag yangs dasu 'khod do/ /'jig rten gyi khams rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed dag na byang chub sems dpa' 'khod pa gang 4yin pa de dag kyang thabs de lta bur lhags te 'khod do/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can yang tshe dang ldan pa 'od srung dang / gnas brtan kun dga' bo dang / rgyal po ma skyes dgra rnams zim gtogs par der ma 'ongs pa su yang med dephyi/ tha na mi gdug pa dang ske/ sbrul gdug pa dang / sdig pa dang 7/ sdom la sogs pa las mi bzad pa bcu drug byed pa yan chad kyang der lhags so/ /sbyin byed ma'i bu dang / lha ma yin rtag tu 'khon 8gyi bsam pa can thams cad kyang sdig pa'i las spangs nas gcig la gcig bu dang / ma dang / sring mo dang 'dra bar sems par gyur to/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na 'khod pa'i sems can thams cad kyang gcig la gcig bu gcig pa la bya ba bzhin du byams par byed de/ 'dod chen po ni ma gtogs so/ /mi mjed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'di yang de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus bong ba dang / rdo dang / gseg ma dang / rdu ba dang / tsher ma med par gyur te/ shing ljon pa rin po che'i 'khri shing gis dkris pa/ mnyen zhing reg na 'jam pa dag dang ldan zhing /'jig rten gyi khams bde ba can dang 'dra bar gyur to/ /sems can der 54—44

lhags pa thams cad kyis kyang de na 'khod bzhin du/ ji ltar me long gi ngos la rang gi gzugs brnyan snang ba bzhin du/ rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'byor pa dang ldan pa gzhan dag kyang mthong ngo / /de nas de bzhin gshegs pa'i zhal nas 'od zer kha dog sna tshogs sngon po dang / ser po dang / dmar po dang / dkar po dang / bcod ka dang ske/ shel gyi kha dog lta bu dang / me lce lta bu dag byung ba gang yin pa de dag gis bya ba gang yin pa de dag gi 1 bya ba thams cad byas te phyir log nas/bcom ldan 'das nyid kyi zhal du zhugs te mi snang bar gyur to/ /'khor thams cad kyi 'od kyang des zil gyis gnon par gyur to/ /de nas lha dang / mi dang ske/ lha ma yin dang bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis 'od zer de dag bcom ldan 'das kyi zhal du mi snang bar gyur pa mthong nas/ 'jigs shing skyi bung 2zhes byas te/ rgyu med par bcom ldan 'das kyi 'od zer rnams phyir log 3nas mi snang bar 'gyur ba'i mi rigs na/ gor ma chag 4par phyogs bcu dag tu bya ba rnams zin nas da ni gdon mi za bar de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis gang las kyang zhal zas ma bzhes nam/ kye ma sems can thams cad la tshad med pa bzhi spangs sam/ ci smyung bar bzhugs par chad dam/ kye ma ci nyi ma dang zla ba nub bam/ ci dam pa'i chos kyi gru bying ngam/ kyi hud kyi hud ces bla zhing 'khod do/ /de nas de dag rang rang gi 5yan lag rnams mas 6par byas pa'i khrag gis sa gzhi 'dam du gyur to/ /chu klung gser ldan yang khrag tu 'bab par gyur to/ /de nas 'khor de dag gi nang na grong khyer ku shi pa mgar ba'i bu dge bsnyen skul byed ces bya ba 54—45

de mgar ba'i bu bcwa 1lnga dang thabs cig tu langs nate/ rang rang gi spyod lam bcos nas 'jig rten dag la bltas 3te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nasal/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs 4te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ mchi ma mi thub bzhin du zhabs la phyag 'tshal te/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag ni sems can thams cad nges par bsgral ba'i slad du/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pa la zhal zas kyi tha ma dbul bar 'tshal te/bdag ni mgon ma mchis pa lags/ rtsa lag ma mchis pa lags/ skyabs ma mchis pa lags/ phongs te re ba lags na/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bdag gis phul ba'i zhal zas bzhes te/ yongs su mya ngan las mi 'da' bar mdzad du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das dper gsol na khyim bdag gam bram ze shin tu dbul po 'ga' zhig gzhan gyi yul du mchis la/ bdag nyid spro ba bskyed de mthar gyis zhing las brtsams nas/ des rmon glang rmo skyen pa thong gshol dang sbyar ba dag gis zhing la rdo dang / rdu ba dang / tsher ma tshom mchis par bgyis te / re ba chen po bskyed nas sprin chen po las char 'bab pa sdod cing mchis pa de bzhin du/ bcom ldan 'das bdag ni lus kyi zhing la nyes pa gsum dang /bzhi dang bral ba'i yid dang ngag gi rmon glang dang shes pa'i thong gshol gyis nyon mongs pa rnam pa sna tshogs kyi rdo dang / rdu ba dang / tsher ma ma mchis par bgyis nas/ khyod kyi chos kyi sprin chen po las chos kyi char pa 'bab pa la sdod cing mchis te/ dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas par spyan 'dren na/54—46

bdag gi dbul ba bsal 1ba dang / sems can thams cad la sman pa'i slad dul/ bdag gis phul ba'i zhal zas bzhes su gsol/ bdag ni mgon ma mchis pa/ skyabs ma mchis pa lags na/ de bzhin gshegs pas bdag la sgra gcan zin bzhin du gzigs par gsol/ de nas bcom ldan 'das thams cad mkhyen pa rgyal ba gang zag bla na med pas mgar ba'i bu skul byed la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /skul byed de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis khyod kyi zhal zas tha ma sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa chen po bzhes par mdzad do/ /de nas lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin de dag gis skul byed kyis phul ba'i zhal zas kyi tha ma sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa chen po de bzhin gshegs pa dge slong gi dge 'dun dang bcas pas bzhes so zhes thos nas ngo mtshar rmad du byung ba'i chos thob ste/ legs so legs so zhes skad chen po phyung nas mgar ba'i bu skul byed la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kye mgar ba'i bu skul byed khyod skyid de ba khyod kyis mi lus thob pa ni phan thogs par gyur to/ /legs par thob bo/ /skul byed 'jig rten na u dum bā nara'i me tog bzhin 3du mdzes pa ni rnyed par dka'o/ /de bas kyang ches de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba rnyed par dka'o/ /de bas kyang dad pa rnyed pa shin tu dka'o / /de bas kyang ches chos thos pa rnyed par dka'o/ /de bas kyang ches de bzhin gshegs pa la zhal zas kyi tha ma dbul lab rnyed par dka'o / /de bas na zhal zas kyi tha ma sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa thob pa mgar ba'i bu skul tshobyed khyod la phyag 'tshal lo/ /dper na ston zla 'bring po nya la sprin med pa'i tshe zla ba'i dkyil 'khor dri ma med pa mdzes pa mthong ba na zla ba 'ba' zhig mngon du 54—47

snang ba de bzhin du/ khyod kyis phul ba'i zhal zas kyi tha ma de bzhin gshegs pas bzhes pas na khyod 'ba' zhig sems can thams cad la mngon du snang ngo / /khyod la ya nga dang yang du phyag 'tshal lo/ /skul byed khyod ni mi'i lus byed bzhin du lha'i yang lha yin no/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sras sgra gcan zin dang 'dra'o zhes byas nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag kyang smras so/ /khyod ni mi ma yin te lha mchog yin/ /mi mchog gtso bo khyad par 'phags pa ste/ /de phyir khyod la gsol ba 'di skad 'debs/ /ston pa yongs su mya ngan 'da' bar chas/ /bdag cag kun la brtse bas skul byed khyod/ /skye bo rnams la yun du phan pa'i phyir / /'dir ni ston pa dpag med mgon po la/ /bzhugs shing rgyun du bdud rtsi ston ces gsol/ /srid las rnam grol mya ngan 'da' bzhed la/ /gal te khyod kyis de ring ma gsol na/ /bdag cag thams cad ma rung shes par gyis / /de bas phan phyir mgon la gsol ba thob/ /de nas la la zhig pha ma gnyis shi ba las phyir sos te gson por 'dug pa mthong na mchog tu dga' bar gyur pa de kho na bzhin du mgar ba'i bu skul byed de mchog tu dga' bar gyur nas lag pa brkyang ste/ bcom ldan 'das la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas langs te tshigs su bcad 1pa 'di dag smras so/ /kye ma deng bdag rnyed pa legs par rnyedam/ /mi yi 'jig rten skyes pa 'bras bu yod/ /da ni rnyed la sogs las 'bral mi 'gyur/ /mi bzad dmyal bar yang ni ltung mi 'gyur/ /deng 'dir rnyed pa chen po rnyed pa 'di/ /gser gyi phung po bas kyang lhag pa yin/ /dpa' bo bde gshegs mgon dang phrad pas na/ /phyin chad 2bdag ni dud 'gro'i 'jigs 3pa med/ /sangs rgyas la ni dad pa gting zug pa/ /deng rnyed u 54wa 48

dum bā 1ra'i me tog bzhin/ /rab 'jigs yi dgas 'gro ba yongs spangs shing ske/ /lha min skye ba'i sa bon mi bzad nabacom/ /de bzhin gshegs 'byung dkon dang deng phrad pa/ /khab kyi rtse mor yungs 'bru chags pa bzhin/ /de la pha rol phyin mchog sbyin phul bas/ /rtag tu lha yi ca'agro bar 'phar bar gyur50/ /chu gnas pad ma chus mi chags pa ltar/ /drang srong chen po 'jig rten chos rnams kyis/ /chags med phrad pas srid rtse'i sa bon kun/ /drungs phyung bdag nyid 'khor ba'i mtsho chen rgal/ /rgya mtsho'i nang gi ru 0sbal zhar ba'i mgrin/ /gnya' 7shing mig tu chud dka' na'adra ba las/ /bde gshegs deng phrad de la sbyin pa phul/ /de 9na bdag gis nyon mongs gsog kun bcom/ /lha rnams kyis ni zhal zas bzang po dag /phul yang bde gshegs ma bzhes bdag las ni/ /e raṇ+ḍa 1 yi me tog 'dra bzhes 11des/ /bdag ni 'jig rten rab mchog dpal yon can/ /tshangs pa brgya byin la sogs 'jig rten 'di/ /thams cad lhags te gus par bdag la mchod/ /khyu mchog gnas su son pa gang yin 'di/ /skye ba 'di nyid la ni bdag gis thob/ /de nas thal mo sbyar te bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /mgon khyod mya ngan 'da' ba mthong nas ni/ /'jig rten 'di kun sdug bsngal gzir bar gyur/ /dbang med kyi hud ces ni skad cher bla/ /'di dag ma dor 12rtag tu sras bzhin gzigs / /lhun po'i gser gyi rtse mo rab mtho ba/ /mtsho chen dbus na mdzes par gnas pa ltar/ /chos kyi mnga' bdag khyod ni chos ston cing / /dge 'dun dbus su mdzes par bzhugs su gsol/ /ji ltar nyi ma gzi can shar ba na / /'od zer dag gis sprin srab sel ba ltar/ /drang srong chen po ye shes sgron 54—49

chen gyis/ /skye bo mang po'i mya ngan deng bsal 1mdzod/ /sems can 'di dag ngud namos mig spangs shing / /sdug bsngal gcig pu'i rgya mtsho'i gting du zhugs / /de phyir dad pa rnyed dka' skyed /mdzad cing / /'di rnams sdug bsngal chod la yun du bzhugasal/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis skul byed la bka' stsal pa/ skul byed de ni de bzhin no/ /de ni de bzhin te/ sangs rgyas 'byung ba ni u dum bā 5ra'i me tog bzhin 6shin tu rnyed 7par dka'o/ /dad pa yang rnyed par dka'o/ /chos thos pa yang rnyed par dka'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i tshe zhal zas kyi tha ma'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa phun sum tshogs pa yang rnyed par dka'o/ /skul byed gzhan yang khyod ma ngu mya ngan ma byed par bdag gis de bzhin gshegs pa la zhal zas kyi tha ma'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa phun sum tshogs pa thob bo snyam du dga' ba skyed cig dang / de bzhin gshegs pa la bcom ldan 'das bzhugs su gsol zhes de skad du khyod gsol ba ma 'debs shig /sangs rgyas rnams kyi nachos kyi de kho na nyid la rtogs shig /mi rtag pa nyid la 'jug par gyis shig /'du byed rnams kyi rang bzhin shes par gyis shig ces bka' stsal nas tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsungs so/ /tshe ni shin tu ring yang 'jig par 'gyur/ /'dir ni thams cad nges par 'chi bar 'gyur/ /'tsho ba'i 'jig rten 'jig pa'i chos can yin/ /'byor pa thams cad rgyad par gzhol bar 'gyur/ /rtag tu lang tsho rga bas nges par 'joms/ /gzugs bzang 0nad med nad kyis 'jig par 'gyur/ /srog ni 'chi bas rtsa nas 'byin par byed/ /'jig rten kun na rtag pa ci yang med/ /dbang phyug mi rtag tshe yang mi rtag ste/ /skye bo sdug 54—50
