nas dong ste/ de dag dga' ba sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i tshal ga la ba der phyin to/ /de'i tshe dga' ba sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i tshal de ni byang chub sems dpa' bcu gcig 'jig rten rnams kyi don la sems phan par sems/ bde bar sems shing 'khod pa bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu 1nyi mas byin de dga' ba sna tshogs zhes bya ba'i tshal de na 'khyam dpas dga' ba sna tshogs kyi tshal de na 'khod pa'i skyes bu dam pa de dag des shing 'grogs na bde la mi rgod ma 5khengs mi g.yeng / mu cacor mi smra/ smra ba mi mnga' zhing dran pa nye bar gzhag 6la/shes rab can/ shes rab dang ldan pa/ shin tu grims par gnas par mthong ngo ske/ /mthong nas des dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed cing yun 7ring por shes rab yongs su bsgoms 8pa dang 'phags pa'i rigs la bsten pas skyes 9bu dam pa de dag la sems rab tu dang bar gyur to/ /de sems rab tu dang bas skyes bu dam pa bcu gcig po de dag ga la ba der bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i 1 bu g.yog rnams dang lhan cig tu dong ngo / /skyes bu dam pa grags byin des bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin rgyang ring po 1 nas 'ong ba mthong ngo / /mthong nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po 12lta bu'i bu de'i 'gro ba dang / ldog pa dang / lta ba dang / smyung 1 ba dang / bskum pa'i spyod pa kun kyang tshangs par spyad pa yun ring du spyad pa'i spyod lam bzhin te/ skyes bu dam pa 'di bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi snod du 'gyur ro snyam du sems so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu grags byin gyis skyes bu dam pa bcu gcig po de dag la 'di skad ces smras so/ /tshe dang ldan pa dag 'di ltar nyi mas byin skyes bu dam pa sangs rgyas kyi sras kyi tshul du 'gro ba/ bla na med pa 51—704

sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams kyi snod du gyur pa 'ong gis 1byang chub sems dpa' 'di la skyes bu dam pa rnams kyis snying rje bskyed la gdams pa dang / rjes su bstan pas ci nas rigs kyi bu 'di skye bo phal po che'i don byed cing snang ba ston pa snang bar bya ba'i phyir legs par dgongs shig /de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin skyes bu dam pa bcu gcig po de dag gi gan du song nas 'di dag ni ston pa'o/ /'di dag 2ni 'phags pa'o zhes 3skyes bu dam pa de dag la ston par 'du shes bskyed de/ des skyes bu dam pa de dag gi rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal nas phyogs gcig tu 'greng lango / /de nas rigs kyi bu grags byin gyis bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin de la kye bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu 5nyi mas byin khyod 'dug cig 6ces smras nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin skyes bu dam pa de dag la shin tu ri mo bskyed de 'dug pa ni 'di lta ste/dper na rigs kyi mna' ma gyos sgyug gi mdun na 'dug pa bzhin du dam pa de dag la ri mo skyes par gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na nad pa nad kyis btab nas yun ring mo las sman pa mthong na dbugs byung ba de bzhin du bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin de yang rigs kyi bu 7de dag mthong ma thag tu dbugs byung bar gyur to/ /'di lta ste/ dper na gsad 8pa la thug pa'i mi gsad 9du bkri ba las don bya bar 'dod phan par 'dod bde bar 'dod pa'i mi 0la la zhig byung ste/ des de gsad pa las thar bar byas nas de mi de la 'di ni bdag gi skyabs/ bdag la snying brtse ba can zhes de byas pa gzo ba cher skyes pa bzhin du/ bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i 54—705

bu nyi mas byin yang skyes bu dam pa de dag la bdag gi skyabs/1 bdag la snying brtse ba can no zhes byas pa gzo ba skyes so/ /de nas rigs kyi bu grags byin gyis bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin la smras pa/ nyi mas byin de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs ‘rgyas rnams 'jig rten du 'byung ba rnyed napar dka'o/ /'di lta ste/ dper na u dum wā ra'i me tog brgya la brgya lam na 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ba de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang brgya la brgya lam na 'jig rten du 'byung ste/ gang 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun pa/ 'jig rten thams cad dang 'gal ba/ zab pa mthong bar dka' ba/ rtogs par dka' ba/ brtag tu med pa/ mu stegs can gzhan thams cad kyi rtog ge'i spyod yul ma yin pa/ nyan thos rnams kyis ma chud pa / rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis mi shes pa/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyi spyod yul ma yin pa'i chos ston to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de la khyod kyis gus pa bskyed par bya'o/ /bste ristang dang bcas/ ri mo dang bcas pa la ni shes rab yang dag par gnas shing byams pa bskyed/ ye shes rab tu 'byung /rig pa bskyed/ mngon par shes pa mngon du 'gyur/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos rnams mdun na gnas par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun pa'i chos ji ltar ston ce na/ nyi mas byin chos thams cad ni nam mkha' la bris pa bzhin du dngos po med pa ste/ chos de dag ni 'jig rten thams cad dang mi 'thun pa'o/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni ma byung mi 'byung ba de bzhin du nyi mas byin gzugs 51—706

ni nam mkha' lta bu ste ngo bo nyid kyis 'gags pa'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang ske/ 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang nam mkha' lta bu ste ngo bo nyid kyis 'gags pa'o/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la 1byis pa ni ma skyes pa ste/ de bzhin du gzugs kyang ma skyes pa'o/ /tshor ba dang /'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang ma skyes pa'o/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni ma 'gags pa ste/ de bzhin du nyi mas byin gzugs kyang ma 'gags pa'o/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa'ang ma 'gags pa'o/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni mi 'ong mi 2'gro ba de bzhin du nyi mas byin gzugs kyang mi 'ong mi 'gro ste/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang mi 'ong mi 'gro ba'o/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la ni bris pa rim skyes ma byung ba de bzhin du gzugs kyang ma skyes ma byung ste/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang ske/ rnam par shes pa yang ma skyes ma byung ngo / /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni ma 'phos ma skyes pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang ma 'phos ma skyes te/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes capa'ang ma 'phos ma skyes so/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni ma byung kun nas ma byung ba de bzhin du gzugs kyang ma byung kun nas ma byung ste/ tshor 6ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa'ang ma byung kun nas ma byung ngo / /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni ma skyes shing med pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang 54—707

ma skyes shing med pa ste/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang /rnam par shes pa'ang 1ma skyes shing med pa'o/ /nyi mas byin 'di 5lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni ma grub 3mngon par ma grub pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang ma grub mngon par ma grub ste/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang ma grub mngon par ma grub bo/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni cabarjod du med cing brjod pa ma yin pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang brjod du med cing brjod pa ma yin te/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes 5dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang brjod du med cing brjod pa ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa btags 6pa med cing gdags pa ma yin pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang btags 7pa med cing gdags pa ma yin te/ tshor ba dang / 'du shes nadang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang btags 9pa med cing gdags pa ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la 7bris pa ni tha snyad tsam ste/ nam mkha' la bris pa tha snyad tsam las gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang tha snyad tsam ste/ gzugs tha snyad tsam las gzhan ma yin no/ /tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang tha snyad tsam ste/ tha snyad tsam las rnam par shes pa gzhan ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni 'di ltar kun rdzob tsam ste/kun rdzob las nam mkha' la bris pa gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin du nyi mas byin gzugs kyang 'di ltar kun rdzob tsam ste/ kun rdzob las gzugs gzhan ma yin/tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang 'di 54—708

ltar kun rdzob tsam ste/ kun rdzob las rnam par shes pa'i bar du gzhan ma yin rnal/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni 'di ltar ming tsam ste/ ming tsam las nam mkha' la bris pa gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang ming tsam ste/ ming tsam las gzhan ma yin no/ /de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i bar du yang 'di ltar 1ming tsam ste/ ming tsam las rnam par shes pa'i bar du nagazhan ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni 'di ltar rabarjod pa tsam ste/ brjod pa tsam las nam mkha' la bris pa gzhan lam yin pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang 'di ltar brjod pa tsam ste/ brjod pa tsam las gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i bar du yang 'di ltar brjod pa tsam ste/ brjod pa tsam las rnam par shes pa'i bar du gzhan ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ra ste/ dper na nam mkha' la bris pa ni 'di ltar btags pa tsam ste/ btags pa tsam las nam mkha' la bris pa gzhan tshom yin pa de bzhin du gzugs kyang 'di ltar btags pa tsam ste/ btags pa tsam las gzugs gzhan ma yin no/ /tshor ba dang ske/ 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa yang 'di ltar btags pa tsam ste/ btags pa tsam las tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang /'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa gzhan ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/dper na nam mkha' la bris pa 'di ltar 'du shes tsam ste/ 'du shes tsam las nam mkha' la bris pa gzhan ma yin pa chi de bzhin du gzugs nas rnam par shes pa'i bar du yang 'di ltar 'du shes tsam ste/ 'du shes tsam las gzugs nas rnam par shes pa'i bar du gzhan ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper 54wa 709

na nam mkha' la bris pa ni brda tsam ste/ brda tsam las 1nam mkha' la bris pa gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin du gzugs nas rnam par shes pa'i bar du yang 'di ltar brda tsam ste/ brda tsam las gzugs nas rnam par shes pa'i bar du gzhan ma yin no/ /nyi mas byin 'di lta ste/ dper na tshig gang gis nam mkha' la bris par brjod pa'i tshig ni nadon dam par mi dmigs pa de bzhin du 'di lta ste/gzugs dang / tshor ba dang / 'du shes dang / 'du byed dang / rnam par shes pa zhes bya ba'i chos de dag kyang 'das pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang ma cadamigs/ ma byon pa dang / da ltar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyis kyang ma dmigs so/ /nyi mas byin ye shes de rtogs par bya ba'i phyir sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams sngon byang chub sems dpa'i 5spyad pa spyod pa na sdug cing phangs tshopa'i dngos po thams cad yongs su btang yang zhum par mi 'gyur te/gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni 'jig rten du rtogs 7par mi blta'o/ /gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni 'jig rten gyi grangs su mi 'gro'o/ /gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni gdags par bya ba ma yin no/ /gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas son/ snye/gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni 'khor ba las bskyod pa ma yin no/ /gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni 'khor ba'i chos can yang ma yin no/ /mya ngan las 'das pa'i chos can yang ma yin no/ /gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni kun nas nyon mongs pa'i chos can ma yin/ rnam par byang ba'i chos can ma yin no/ /gang ye shes 'di la gnas pa de dag ni zhi bar spyod pa yang ma yin / ma zhi bar spyod pa yang ma yin no/ /de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la 51—710

chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin gyis skyes bu dam pa grags byin gyis bshad pa la legs so zhes shin tu bstod de rjes su yi rang ngo / /de nas yang skyes bu dam pa bcu gcig po de dag gis bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin de rab tu dga' bar bya ba'i phyir bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin de la 'di skad ces smras so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis chos zab mo 'di thos kyang ma skrag 1skrag par ma gyur/ shin tu skrag par ma gyur/ ma myos myos par ma gyur pa legs so legs so/ /rigs kyi bu khyod kyis gang la bslab par bya ba'i sa ni 'di yin nano/ /de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin zab mo gos pa med pa'i chos bstan pa 'di thos nas tshim zhing mgu ste yi 5rangs nas rab tu dga' ste/ dga' ba dang / yid bde ba skyes nas sangs rgyas kyi chos zab mo mthar phyin par gyur to// //bam po bdun pa ste tha ma/ de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin dang / skyes bu dam pa bcu gcig po de dag de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dga' mchog ces bya ba de ga la ba der dong ste phyin nas bcom ldan 'das de'i zhabs la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te phyogs gcig tu 'khod do/ /de nas skyes bu dam pa grags byin des bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dga' mchog de la tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gsol to/ /zhi ba'i dbyings la rab zhugs 4tshul rnams la/ /mkhas pa 'dren pa rnams ni legs so zhes5/ /gang gis 6mi mchog shin tu 'thob 7'gyur ba/ /de ni mi rnams dam pa bstan du gsol/ /'jig rten mkhas pas bstan pa thos nas su/ /byang chub mchog la mi rnams rab tu 'jug /54—711

gang thos drang srong chen por 'gyur ba dag1 /tshul de srog chags rnams la sman slad gsungs/ /bde gshegs bdag gi rigs la gnas nas su/ /thub pas sangs rgyas ye shes mngon par bstod/ /rgyal bas de yid rab tu dga' bar mdzadam/ /de dag thos nas shin tu gnas par 'gyur/ /rgyal ba bdag gis ji tsam 'tshal ba rnams/ /'dren pa bdag gis chos rnams bshad lags te/ /ston pas ji ltar chos rnams kun mkhyen 2pa/ /'dren pas legs par ma lus bstan du gsol/ /de la dga' mchog 'jig rten 'dren pa yis/ /rgyal sras spyod pa gang la spyad pas na/ /mi yi gtso bo 'dren par 'gyur ba yi/ /sangs rgyas chos rnams ma lus nges par bstan/ /thams cad chos zhes bya ba mtshan nyid gcig /mtshan nyid bral zhing mtshan nyid med pa ste/ /zhi ba nga rimed mi g.yo yon tan med/ /spobs pa med cing zhi ba 'tsho ba med/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par byang bas lastong / /dngos po nyid med cung zad med pa ste/ /'di ni bstan pa ma yin ston pa med/ /bshad pa med cing 'chad par byed pa'ang med/ /tshor ba ma yin tshor ba po yang med/ /shes pa ma yin shes par byed pa'ang med/ /su la'ang ma yin gang gis kyang min te/ /'di dag ma byas byed du bcug pa'ang med/ /sus kyang blangs pa med cing btang ba'ang med/ /sus kyang bsgrags pa med la thos pa'ang med/ /sus kyang mi shes rnam par shes pa'ang med/ /'di dag dngos por sus kyang mthong ba med/ /'di ni zhi ba ma yin rgod pa'ang min/ /zhi bar mi byed zhi bar byas pa'ang med/ /byed pa ma yin byed pa med pa'ang ci min/ /sems pa med cing tshor bar tshobyed pa'ang med / /'dus byas ma yin 'dus ma byas pa'ang min/ /'pho ba ma yin mi 'pho 54—712

ba yang min/ / 'ongs pa 1med cing 'gro ba yod pa minan/ /'di ni kun du mi 'chi skye ba med/ /skye ba med cing bskyed pa'ang ma yin te/ /'di ni 'gags pa med la 'gags pa'ang min/ /'di ni brtan pa med cing bshig pa'ang med/ / de ltar rgyal ba'i chos rnams bshig pa'ang med / /de 4ltar rgyal ba'i chos rnams shes par gyis/ /'dren pa bde bar gshegs pa gang 'das pa/ /de dag gis kyang tshul 'di rab tu bstan/ /'dren pa sangs rgyas ma byon 'byung ba rnams / /de dag kyang ni tshul 'di 'chad par 5'gyur/ /rnam par 'dren pa da 6ltar gang byung ba/ /rgyal ba de dag kun kyang tshul 'di ston/ /chos nyid 'di dag rab tu shes pa yi / /byang chub sems dpa' 'jigs pa med par 'gyur / /zhi ba'i sa yang rab tu shes 'gyur te/ /mkhas pas shes par dka' ba rab tu bstan/ /rgyal ba'i thugs sras ji tsam shes pa dag /'gro ba gtses 8pa 'di la mya ngan med/ /de la snying rje bla na med pa ste/ /'gro ba kun la byams par shin tu gnas / /stong pa nyid la gnas par gyur pas na/ /rgyal ba'i bstan pa dag la the tshom 1 med/ /mtshan ma med par gnas par gyur pas na/ /de la smon lam 'debs pa'ang yong med de/ /rlung rnams nam mkha' dag la mi thogs bzhin/ /dpa' bo de dag 'gro bar mi chags so/ /bskal pa mang por bye bar kun 'khor zhing / /sems can bye ba mang po ston par byed/ /kun du kun nas nyon mongs mi 'gyur te/ /de 1 ni byang chub dam pa 'tshang rgya nus/ /gal te bdud kyis sangs rgyas bye bstan te/ /de dag nyan thos kyis shes smra na yang ske/ /ngas ni chos nyid yang dag rab rtogs te/ /khyod ni 'dren pa min zhes de smra'o/ /dri ma med pa'i ye shes mig sbyangs te/ /bdag ni the tshom 2ma lus 54—713

rnam par byang / /stong par bdag ni gzhan dring gi 1mi 'jog /khyod ni gang zag mchog min phar deng nashig /de ltar rgyal bas chos nyid bstan pas na/ /gang la 'dren 5pa'i sras rnams gnas pa la/ /bye ba khrag khrig bdud kyis thub dka' ste / /ji ltar ri bo bskyod par mi nus bzhin/ /de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dga' mchog de las stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa de dag thos nas 'di lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs thob ste/ dge ba'i kyirtsa ba ji lta bu'i 7thob pas ta la bdun srid du nam mkha' la 'phags te/ des phyogs bcu'i na'ajig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa dag na byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig brgya phrag dpag tu med pa rnams thabs mkhas pa rnam pa tha dad pas byang chub sems dpa' yang dag par sgrub pa mthong / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa rnams dga' ldan gyi gnas nas shi 'phos te/yum gyi lhums su zhugs pa yang mthong / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba dpag tu med pa rnams lha 'bum gyis mchod cing yum gyi rum 9du 'gro ba yang mthong /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med pa rnams btsas snyenas gom 1 pa bdun 'dor ba yang mthong / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa rnams mngon par 'byung ba yang mthong / byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig 'bum phrag dpag tu med pa rnams byang chub mngon par rdzogs par byang chub pa yang mthong / sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa rnams la brgya byin dang tshangs pa dag gis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol pa yang mthong / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med pa rnams chos kyi 54—714

'khor lo bskor ba yang mthong / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med pa rnams spyod lam dpag tu med pa rnams kyis sems can rnams 'dul ba yang mthong ske/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dpag tu med pa rnams phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten na 1phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' batshanayang mthong ngo / /de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin bar snang la 'dug bzhin du bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dga' mchog de la tshigs su bcad pas mngon par bstod pa/ legs so legs so rkang gnyis kun gyi mchog /'dren pa khyod kyis 'di dag chos bstan pa/ /bar snang gnas kyi bya yi rjes bzhin du/ /dngos bral mtshungs med ci yang ma lags pa/ /mtshan ma ma mchis nam mkhar sa bris pa bzhin/ /de ltar bde bar gshegs pas chos bstan te/ /sprul pa dag gis ji ltar gzhan sprul bzhin/ /yang dag tu na rgyal bas bstan ma mchis sos ma'i dus kyi smig rgyu ji bzhin du/ /snang yang yang dag par ni mchis ma lags/de bzhin bde bar gshegs pas chos bstan te/ /ston pa gang lags de yang de dang 'dra/ /sngon chad the tshom nem nur gang byung ba/ /de yang 'dren pa'i drung du bral gyur te/ /bde bar gshegs pas gsungs pa'i chos kyang rig /'gro ba sgrol mdzad rnam par 'dren par shog /stobs bcu dag gis bsgrubs pa ci 'dra bar / /rgyal ba'i zhing mchog bzang po sbyang bar bgyi/ /sangs rgyas rgyal ba rkang gnyis gtsor gyur te/ /skye bo ma rtogs pa rnams rtogs par bgyi/ /srid pa'i rgya mtshos khyer ba'i 'gro ba rnams/ /gnas dang skyabs dang rten kyang ma mchis pa'i/ /skyabs su 'gyur zhing sdug bsngal thar bgyi ste/ /rga shi bral ba'i 51—715

gnas kyang bstan par bgyi/ /bye ba khrag khrig bdud kyi spyod yul ni/ /thams cad rgyal ba'i spyod yul du yang bgyi/ /sems can bdud kyi yul nas bton 1nas su/ /drang srong chen po'i yul du drang bar bgyi/ /bde bar gshegs pas zhi ba'i chos bstan pa/ /gang gis thos nas gang la'ang mi reg 2pa/ /de dag mchog gi tshul la gnas par 'gyur/ /'dren pa srog chags rnams kyi ston par 'gyur / /chos nyid 'di ltar mi gang rab rtogs shing / /ston pa rgyal ba'i dbang po'i spyan snga nas/ /bstan bcos kun la mkhas shing 'jigs bral ba/ /de dag bla na med pa'i bde gshegs 'gyur/ /stong pa 'di nyid gang gis rab rtogs shing / /stong par dmigs pa'i 'du shes bral gyur na / /de dag ma smas bde bar gshegs par 'gyur/ /srog chags bye ba mang po 'grol bar bgyid / /mkhas pa btsog lapa la ni mi dga' ste/ /zas kyi ro rnams la yang chags ma mchis/ /rtogs pa ci dgon pa'i gnas la shin tu mos/ /de dag rkang gnyis dam pa mkhas par 'gyur/ /sbyangs pa gang dag stobs bcus bsngags pa dag /de dag tshortag tu rab tu gnas par 'gyur/ /'phags pa'i rigs la de dag rtag tu dga'/ /rab tu dga' bas byang chub mchog kyang thob/ /de dag chos rnams bde bar gshegs pas bsngags/ /de la mkhas pa gnas pas 'di mthong ste/ /zhi ba gang la bde gshegs gnas pa yi/ /byang chub de ni 'jig rten 'dren pas bsngags/ /'dren pa khyod las stong pa deng thos te/ /ye shes bla na med pa'ang bdag gis bsgrubs/ /sangs rgyas rkang gnyis gtso bor 'gyur bar bgyi/ /mi mkhas 'gro ba dag kyang rnam par dgrol/ /thub pa khyod la bdag ni skyabs su mchi/ /gang la log pa'i blo gros mi dmigs shing / /chos 51—716

rnams kun la khyod ni the tshom 1bral/ /de slad 'jig rten khyod dang 'dra ma mchis / /'dren pa bde bar gshegs la gang dbastod pa'i / /bsod nams mi chung bdag gis bsags pas na/ /bdag ni de yi dge ba'i las 'di yis/ /mi yi cagatso bo 'dren par 'gyur bar shog /de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin gyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dga' mchog de la tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis mngon par bstod nas dge ba'i rtsa ba des bskal pa brjod du med par nams kyang smyos 5pa dang glen par ma gyur to/ /gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der 'dren pa skyes bu chen por gyur to/ / nams kyang 6log par ltung snye bar ma gyur to/ / nams kyang 8gzhan gyi dring la 'jog par ma gyur to/ / nams kyang 9gzhan gyi ngor lta bar ma gyur to/ / nams kyang 1 bskal pa brjod du med par tha na se gol gtogs pa tsam gyi bar du sems can rnams yongs su smin par ma byas par ma gyur to/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon pa 'di ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rigs kyi bu grags byin zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du 'dzin na thams cad zil gyis gnon pa khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ rigs kyi bu bzang skyong zhes bya ba de de'i tshe de'i dus na rigs kyi bu grags byin zhes bya bar gyur to/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon pa 'di ji snyam du sems/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na mkhas pa'i snying por gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du sems na khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba de de'i tshe de'i dus na rigs kyi bu mkhas pa'i snying po zhes bya bar 11gyur to/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon pa 'di ji 2snyam du 54—717

semasal/ de'i tshe de'i dus na tsan dan snying po zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du 'dzin na khyod 1kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/byang chub sems dpa' skyob byin zhes bya ba de 5de'i 3tshe de'i dus na rigs kyi bu tsan dan snying po zhes bya bar gyur to/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon pa 'di ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na rigs kyi bu tshangs pa'i mig ces bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du 'dzin na khyod kyis 4de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' ded dpon bzang po de de'i tshe de'i dus na rigs kyi bu tshangs pa'i mig ces bya bar gyur to/ /de bzhin du sbyar te/gang rigs kyi bu des pa zhes bya bar gyur pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' mes byin yin no/ /gang de'i tshe de'i dus na rigs kyi bu blo gros 'chang zhes bya bar gyur pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' bzang skyong yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na gang rigs kyi bu kun du 'dzin par gyur pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' dbang pos byin yin no/ /de'i tshe de'i dus na gang rigs kyi bu spobs pa mtha' yas su gyur pa de ni byang chub sems dpa' chu'i lha yin no/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon pa 'di ji snyam du sems/ de'i tshe de'i dus na bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin zhes bya bar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du 'dzin na thams cad zil gyis gnon pa khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ / de ci'i phyir zhe na5/ 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa 'di de'i tshe de'i dus na bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu nyi mas byin zhes bya bar gyur to/ /thams cad zil gyis gnon pa de lta bas na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gzhan gyi dring sgyu la mi 'jog pa dang / gzhan gyis mi bkri bar 54—718

'dod pa dang / gzhan gyi ngor mi blta 1bar 'dod na chos kyi dbyings la rab tu 'jug pa'i phyir dge ba'i bshes naganyen rnams la bsten par bya/ 'grogs par bya/ bsnyen bkur bya'o/ /chos zab mo mnyan pa'i phyir yongs su 'dri ba'i ngang tshul can du bya'o/ /de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar stobs bskyed pas chos kyi dbyings la zhugs pa'i 3byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zil gyis gnon pa 'dis yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cigs la dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed lags/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das ji snyed cig la yongs su zhu ba zhus 5lags/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /'jam dpal stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sa dang / rtswa tshodang / shing dang ske/ yal ga dang / lo ma rnams rdul phra rab tu byas kyang bgrang bar nus kyi ske/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zil gyis gnon pas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag las dge ba'i rtsa ba bskyed pa dang / sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la chos kyi dbyings su yongs su zhugs 8pa dang / chos kyi dbyings 9la 'jug pa dang / thabs mkhas pa la 'jug pa yongs su dris pa ni bgrang bar mi nus so/ /'jam dpal sngon byung ba 'das pa'i dus na bskal pa grangs med/ dpag tu med/ ba sam gyis mi khyab/ mtshungs pa med /gzhal du med/ brjod du med pa de'i pha rol gyi yang ches pha rol na zhi ba'i phung po'i bsku ra pa la sangs rgyas kyi zhing dpag tu med cing sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med par yongs su dag pa dang ldan pa brjod du med pa'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing 54wa 719

yongs su dag pa dang ldan par de bzhin gshegs pa/ rig 1pa dang zhabs su ldan pa/ bde bar gshegs pa/ 'jig rten mkhyen pa/ skyes bu 'dul ba'i kha lo sgyur ba/ bla na med pa/ lha dang mi rnams kyi ston pa/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das dbang po'i rgyal mtshan zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing de na yang dge slong dpa' sra zhes bya ba mkhas pa/ yid gzhungs pa/ bye brag phyed pa/rtogs pa/ shes rab kyi rang bzhin can zhig byung ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i rgyal mtshan de la rim gro byed par gyur to/ /des de bzhin gshegs pa dbang po'i rgyal mtshan de la lo bye ba khrag khrig brgyad cu'i bar du shin tu gus par byas te bshad pa 2rnams kyang gzungs su 'dzin cing rang gi don kyang mi gtong ste/des de bzhin gshegs pa la lo bye ba khrag khrig brgyad cu'i bar du thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems kyis rim gro byas te/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa bas sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa rnams mnyes par byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi rim gro byed par gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad la'ang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems kyis bsnyen bkur byas so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyis thog ma dang /bar dang / tha mar dus gsum du bstan pa rnams yongs su bzung bar gyur to / /de'i 'og tu zhi ba'i snying po zhes bya ba'i bskal pa de la sangs rgyas bye ba phrag dgu byung ste/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das de dag thams cad byang chub sems dpa' des yang mnyes par byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams 54—720

cad kyi rim gro byed par gyur te/ de dag thams cad la yang thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems kyis 1rim gro byas nas de bzhin gshegs pa de dag thams cad kyi thog ma dang / bar dang / tha ma dus gsum du bstan pas rnams yongs su bzung ngo / /de'i 'og tu zla 'od ces bya ba'i bskal pa byung ste/ de la de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dkon mchog mkhas pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung ngo / /de bzhin gshegs 3pa dkon mchog mkhas pa'i rgyal po de'i che'i tshad ni bskal pa bye ba phrag brgyad cur gyur te/ de la yang byang chub sems dpa' dpa' sra 4des bskal pa bye ba brgyad 5cu'i bar du yid du 'ong bas bsnyen bkur byas te/ yid du mi 'ong bas ma yin no6/ /de la de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog mkhas pa'i rgyal po zhes bya ba des bskal pa brgyad thucu'i bar du ji ltar chos kyi dbyings la 'jug par 'gyur te/ nam mkha' la bris pa lta bur chos kyi dbyings su 'jug pa bstan to/ /bskal pa bye ba brgyad cu'i bar du chos thams cad nam mkha' la bris pa lta bur bstan te / dpa' sra 'byung ba chen po bzhi ni gzhan du 'gyur yang srid kyi nam mkha' la bris pa lta bu'i chos thams cad ni chung 9zad kyang gzhan du 'gyur ba med do/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' sra ci chos kyi dbyings la 'jug pa 'di thos nas 'di lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs thob ste/ji lta bu'i dge ba'i rtsa ba'i shugs thob pas nam mkha' la ta la bdun srid du 'phags te / des phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams dpag tu med pa na byang chub sems dpa' dpag tu med pa rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar mthong / kha cig ni bla na med 54wa 721

pa'i chos kyi 'khor lo bskor/ kha cig ni rdzu 'phrul gyi cho 'phrul rnam pa du mas sems can rnams 'dul/ kha cig ni tshe'i 'du byed 'dor/ kha cig ni phung po'i lhag ma med pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba mthong nas bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog mkhas pa'i rgyal po de la zab mo'i tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag gis mngon par bstod do / /zhi ba byang chub mtshungs med btsal slad du/ /bdag gis sangs rgyas 'das pa bye stong la/ /shin tu gus pa chen po bskyed nas su/ /sngon gyi 'dren pa dag la bsnyen bkur bgyis/ /sems ni nams kyang 1gzhan du ma bsams ter / /rtag par yid ni stong pa nyid la bzhag /chos rnams stong par bde bar gshegs pas bstan/ /de dag chos kyang yid kyis rnam par bsams no /bdag tu smra 5ba mi gang mi mkhas pa/ /mu stegs can kun bdag gis zil gyis mnan6 / /chos rnams thams cad chu yi 7zla ba bzhin/ /de la bdag ni the tshom cang 8ma mchis/ /mig 'di dam pa'i don du stong par ni/ /bde bar gshegs pas bshad pa thos nas rtogs/ /mig 9'di mig tu mchis pa ma lags te / /mdzangs 1 pa ma lags mi rnams 'di la slad11/ /nges par sna lce rna ba de bzhin te/ /lus kyang ngo bo nyid kyis mchis ma lags/ /de bzhin sems dang sems pa'ang 2stong pa nyid/ /sems ni dben zhing rab tu stong pa lags/ /gzugs kyang gzugs kyis rnam par dben zhing stong / /sgra dang dri dang ro dang reg kyang stong / /chos rnams thams cad ngo bo nyid stong ste/ /skye mched de dag ngo bo nyid kyis stong / /de bzhin khams kyang khams rnams nyid kyis stong / /bden pa'ang bden pas de bzhin stong pa ste/ / 'di la 1 mdzangs 1 pa ma 54—722

lags 'gro ba rnams kyang bslad1/ /gang na'ang na stong par rig pa ma mchis par / /nam mkha' bar snang bya yi rjes dang mtshungs/ /gang na'ang ngo bo nyid ni ma mchis pa/ /de ni nams kyang gzhan 4gyi rgyur 5mi 'gyur/ /gang gis 6ngo bo nyid ni mi rnyed par / /rang bzhin de med ji ltar gzhan gyis rkyen/ /rang bzhin med pa gzhan gyis ci zhig skyed9/ /rgyu de bde bar gshegs pas bstan pa'ol/ /thams cad chos kyang mi g.yo brtan par gnas/ /mi 'gyur 'tshe ba ma mchis zhi ba ste/ /ji ltar nam mkha' rig pa ma mchis ltar/ /de la mi mdzangs 'gro ba myos par 'gyur/ /ji ltar ri bo dag ni mi sgul 11ba/ /de bzhin chos rnams rtag tu bskyod mi nus/ /'chi 'pho ma mchis skye ba ma mchis pa'i chos rnams de ltar rgyal bas rab tu bstan/ /gang gis yang dag chos rnams nges rtogs pa/ /des ni rgyal ba rnam 'dren bsnyen bkur bgyis/ /gang la 'di 'dra'i nan tan ma mchis pa/ /de dag rgyal ba'i chos nyid mchod ma bgyis/ / gang gis 12tshul bzhin rab tu chos rtogs pa/ /des ni rgyal ba bde gshegs bkur ster bgyis/ /de dag rgyal ba chos kyis mchod bgyis te/ /byang chub mchog tu de dag 'tshang yang rgya ri/ /gang gis tshul bzhin chos rnams rab rtogs pa / /mkhas pa de dag rgyal ba'i rigs kyang 'dzin/ /bde bar gshegs pa'i bstan pa des bzung ste/ /byang chub dam pa mchog tu 'tshang yang rgya/ /rgyal ba brgya yis stong pa nyid bshad de/ /byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig rnams kyis bzung 1 / /bde bar gshegs pa'i shul 'dir byang chub phyir/ /de la mkhas pa the tshom gzhar dmi 'byung / /bde bar gshegs pas chos rnams gang bstan pa/ /chos nyid de ni de ring bdag gis 'tshal/ /'dren pa mi rnams kyi yang mchog tu 54—723

'gyur / /shin tu sdug bsngal skye bo rnam 1par dgrol/ /'di ltar stong pa nyid ni rig pas na/ /bdag gis de ring chos kyi yab la mchod/ /gang slad mi yi gtso bo khyod 'phags pas/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de la skyabs su mchi/ /de nas byang chub sems dpa' dpa' sras bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dkon mchog mkhas pa'i rgyal po la stong pa nyid dang ldan pa'i tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis mngon par bstod pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba des gang dang gang du skyes pa de dang der yang gzungs dang / zhi gnas dang / shes rab kyis sems can thams cad zil gyis mnan to/ /'jam dpal de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems 2dpa' dpa' srar gyur pa de gzhan zhig yin pa snyam du da'adzin na 'jam dpal khyod kyis de ltar mi blta'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad zil gyis gnon 4pa 'di ni 5de'i tshe de'i dus na byang chub sems dpa' dpa' sra tsizhes bya bar gyur 7to/ /de lta bas na 'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa rnams yongs su sbyang bar 'dod pas stong pa nyid rnam par thar pa'i sgo la bslab par bya'o/ /de la slob pa'i tshe yang sems gang la yang mi 8chags mi thogs 9te/de'i sems ma chags shing thogs pa med pas bya ba gang dang gang la dmigs pa de dang de yang mngon sum 0du 'gyur ro/ /'jam dpal nga stong pa nyid 'di la slob nga/ na/ ye shes ji lta bu rab tu thob 11pas ji ltar bsams spyo pa de bzhin du 'gyur zhing gar 'dod nga/ der 'gyur ba'i ye shes de lta bu rab tu thob bo/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcu 'das pa na rtag tu snang bar byas zhes bya ba'i /'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can 54—724

rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shugs 'chang zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing bcwa 1brgyad 'das napa na rin chen yod ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dag pa'i spyan zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing drug cu 'das pa na/ dge ba bsags zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don thams cad sems pa zhes bya bar shes so / /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brgya 'das pa na bai dur+ya'i snying po zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de / de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gser gyi phung po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi 5zhing sa ya phrag gnyis 'das pa na 6gser du snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de / de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dpal gyi snying po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing stong brgyad brgya 'das pa na 8zhi ba spyod ‘ ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa 0yang das par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang po'i rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'bum 'das pa na sprin gyi kha dog ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin 54—725

gshegs 1pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas stobs kyi rgyal po 2zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing sum brgya 'das pa na yid du 'ong ba'i dri zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ri'i rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing sum khri brgyad stong 'das pa na me long dkyil 'khor snang zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spos kyi rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so / /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas risangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag brgyad cu 'das pa na zla ba snang ba ri5zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rga shi 'joms pa zhes bya bar shes sol/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing bye ba phrag dgu bcu 'das pa na dus las 'das zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dge sbyong rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing gang gā'i klung gi bye ma snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na/ tshe mnyam zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas spos mchog ces bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi 54—726

phyogs char 'jig rten gyi khams gang gā'i klung gi bye ma dang mnyam pa phrag sum cu rtsa brgyad 'das pa na zhi ba'i cho ga zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas blo gros dag pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing drug cu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na ma smad pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de1/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rin chen bkod pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa nacin rin po che kun du gnas pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gzi brjid 'phags pa'i rgyal pos zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brtul zhugs spyad ces bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bcwa brgyad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na yid grub ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 54—727

gtsug phud rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na nges par song ba zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gtsug phud 'byung zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa nyi shu rtsa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na grong rdal zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas thams cad zil gyis gnon pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na bde ba'i dri zhes ①bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gnas med par spyod ces bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa gcig gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na me tog bkram pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbang phyug ces bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs rinachar sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa brgyad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na tsam pa'i kha dog ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi 54—728

khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas grags pa'i lha zhes bya bar shes so//'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bzhi bcu'i rdul phra rab kyi0rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na lhas sprul pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pakhumi gnas pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bzhi bcu rtsa gcig gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul gasnyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na rab tu grub pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dbyangs kyi rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bdun cu rtsa gcig gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na ma smad pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa sman gyi rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bdun cu rtsa bzhi'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na gser du snang ba zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa mi rtag gzi brjid rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char gser gyis rab tu brgyan ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa gsol ba byed pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal 54—729

shar gyi phyogs char gser gyi gtsug ces bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa nyon mongs dri ma sbyangs zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bzhi bcu rtsa bzhi'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams 'das pa na mngon par 'phags pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de / de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi snying po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char snang ba can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dpal brtsegs zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa gcig gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na grags can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa nyon mongs pa zhi bar byed pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na gzi brjid can zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros 'dzin ces bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum (37chu rtsa drug gi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na tshangs pa 'byung ba zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dpal gyi gzi brjid rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing 51—730

brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa bdun gyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na sangs rgyas dgyes pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa blo gros rgyal po zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa brgyad kyi rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na rin chenas1sgo zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa 'jig rten slob dpon zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa bzhi'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na rin po che'i rtse mo zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa skar rgyal zhes bya bar shes sol/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na rin chen me tog shin tu rgyas pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa sa dang mnyam pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa bzhi'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na shin tu mdzes zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa don thams cad gzigs pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa sum cu rtsa lnga'i rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na 54—731

tsan 1dan gyi dri zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa mtha' yas snang ba zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal shar gyi phyogs char sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing brjod du med pa bzhi bcu'i /rdul phra rab kyi rdul snyed kyi sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'das pa na zil gyis mi non pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams yod de/ de na nga la sems can rnams kyis de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas don thams cad grub pa zhes bya bar shes so/ /'jam dpal de lta bu'i rnam grangs su sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa rnams su sangs rgyas kyi bya ba byed pa'i tshe nga lal sems can rnams kyis ming tha dad par shes pa ni brjod du med pa'i bskal par 5smras kyang shar gyi phyogs cha'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing gi mtha' rtogs par mi nus so/ /de bzhin du phyogs cha thams cad kyi 6sangs rgyas kyi zhing du nga la sems can rnams kyis ming tha dad pa'i de bzhin gshegs par shes pa yang brjod du med pa'i bskal par smras kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing tha dad pa'i mtha' bde bar mi rig go/ /'jam dpal sems can dge ba'i rtsa ba chung ba rnams kyis nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa thos na mos 7par 'gyur ro / /'jam dpal byang chub sems dpa' gang theg pa 'di la yang dag par zhugs pa dang / theg pa 'di la yang dag par zhugs pa'i dge ba'i bshes gnyen rab tu mgu bar byas pa de dag kyang 'jam dpal nga'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa thos na the tshom skye bar 'gyur na nyan thos kyi theg pa can dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa can dang / de ma yin pa'i byis pa so so'i skye bo rnams lta ci smos/ 'jam dpal ngas mngon 8par shes pa 'das pa'i dus na 54wa 732

bskal pa dpag tu med grangs med/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa de'i pha rol gyi yang ches pha rol na yon tan rab tu bskyed pa zhes bya ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams na de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas brtson 'grus mtha' yas zhes bya ba 'jig rten du byung 1ste/ de'i tshe de'i dus na nga ni bram ze'i bu mo blo gros mtha' yas zhes bya bar gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas de yang byang chub sems dpa' khrag khrig brgyad cus yongs su bskor bar gyur te/ byang chub sems dpa' de dag thams cad kyang theg pa chen po la yang dag par zhugs pa theg pa dpag tu med pa la yang dag par zhugs pa nas theg pa brjod du med pa'i bar la yang dag par zhugs pa sha stag ste/ de dag la bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas de'i rang gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa yongs su dag pa 'chad de/ nga yang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'dod pa'i phyir bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas de la rim gro dang bsnyen bkur byas so/ /de nas ngas de'i sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa yongs su dag pa thos nas bdag gi sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang de bas kyang shin tu rgya che ba de 'dra bar gyur cig ces de lta bu'i smon lam btab nas bdag gis dge ba'i rtsa ba thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya cher yongs su dag par bya ba'i phyir bsngos te / bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas des bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa yongs su dag par lung bstan 2mod kyi 'on kyang ngas bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi phyir sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya cher yongs su dag par bya 54—733

ba'i phyir 1brtson 'grus ma btang bar gyur nas de ltar ngas de'i 'og tu sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig tshad med pa rnams la bsnyen bkur byas te/ de'i dge ba'i rtsa ba bsags pas nga sangs rgyas kyi zhing rgya cher yongs su dag par bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis de'i tshe tshigs su bcad pa 'di dag bka' stsal to/ /brjod kyis mi lang 'khor ba na/ /bsam gyis mi khyab 'das pa'i dus/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi rgya bskyed phyir/ /de na nga yis brtson 'grus brtsams/ /brtson 'grus mtha' yas zhes bya ba/ /gang zag mtshungs pa med pa byung / /sems can bye ba rnam par 'dul/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten rnams la ston/ /sangs rgyas chos la dbang byed cing / /stobs rnams kyi yang pha rol phyin/ /mi 'jigs pa la shin tu gnas/ /so so yang dag rig la mkhas/ /gnas dang gnas min dbang yang thob/ /las dang ye shes rtogs par rig /las rnams yang dag 'dzin pa dang / /rnam par smin la the tshom med/ /khams rnams du mar shes pa dang / /rnam par 'dren pa shin tu ldan/ /sems can rnams kyi dad pa rnams/ /ma lus yang dag rab tu mkhyen/ /sems can rnams kyi dbang po yi/ /rim pa bzhin du yang dag mkhyen/ /dbang po mchog dang tha ma rnams / /ma lus par yang rab tu mkhyen/ /bsam gtan ye shes rnam thar dang ske/ /ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol phyin/ /snyoms par 'jug dang tshad med la/ /rkang gnyis dam pa shin tu bslabs3/ /sangs rgyas rnams kyi ting nge 'dzin/ /des ni mi mkhyen gang yang med/ /thams cad mkhyen cing thams cad gzigs/ /gzigs pa la yang sgrib pa med/ /de bzhin gshegs pa de la ngas/ /sangs 54—734

rgyas zhing gi rgya dris te/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi rgya che ba/ /bskal pa chen po bdag la gsungs/ /kun nas nyon mongs rnam par byang / /ma lus yang dag rab tu mkhyen/ /gang rnams khyod kyis mi mkhyen pa/ /de 'dra'i chos ni yong 1ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi skyon narnams dang / /yon tan thams cad rab tu mkhyen/ /sangs rgyas bstan pa rgya che ba/ /rkang gnyis gtso bos dbashad du gsol / /sems can rnams kyi smin pa dang / /ji ltar mi rnams 'tshang rgya ba/ /nyon mongs gang gis nyon mongs cadapas/ /mi mkhas 'khor bar rab tu 'khor/ /mi rnams gang gis nyon mongs pa/ /nyon mongs de dag khyod kyis mkhyen/ /de yi lam dang bsam pa rnams/ /'dren pa khyod kyis rnam par mkhyen/ /ji ltar ting 'dzin 'byung ba dang / /byung nas ji ltar gnas pa dang / /ji ltar de las ldang ba rnams/ /ston pa khyod kyis rab tu mkhyen/ /bsam gtan rnams dang tshad med pa/ /ji snyed ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / /zhi gnas dang ni lhag mthong rnams/ /rnam pa thams cad shin tu mkhyen/ /ji ltar chos la 'dogs pa dang / gang gi rarkyen gyis bshad pa yang / /de yang ston pas rab mkhyen te//de la the tshom mi mnga' khyod/ /khyod kyis bskal pa byer spyad pas/ /ye shes 'di las nges par 'byung ne/ /ston pas stobs kyi 7mthu yang brnyesan/ /drang srong chen po stobs dang ldan/ /bskal pa stong phrag bye ba yi/ /bdag dang pha rol rnams kyi yang / /spyod pa dpag tu ma mchis shing / /bsam gyis mi khyab thams cad mkhyen/ /gang du byang chub ci 'dra ba/ /skye ba thams cad du yang 'jug /de dag ma lus 'dren pa yis/ /ji lta bu 9yang rab tu mkhyen/ /gang du ji 'dra skye ba dang / /gang du rigs kyang ci 1 'dra ba/ /ji ltar kun du spyad pa rnams/ /54—735

de dag 'dren pas rab tu mkhyen/ /tha ma'i chos rnams ci 1'dra ba/ /'dren pas 'khor ba de rnams kyang / /'gro ba gang du skye ba ni/ /de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu mkhyen/ /ci na'adra ba yi ye shes kyis/ /sngon chad rnam par 3lung bstan pa/ /mkhas pa khyod kyis de mkhyen pas/ /de la the tshom mi mnga' khyod/ /tshul khrims gang dang chos gang dang / /ci ca'adra'i spyod pa spyad pa dang / /ye shes gang la zhugs pa yang / /de dag 'dren pas rab tu mkhyen/ /gang dang gang gi las kyis gsu/ /skye ba rnams su 'gro bar 'gyur/ /rnam smin ci 6'dra 'thob 7pa yang / /de dag mgon pos rab tu mkhyen/ /gang du gnas pa de dag gi/ /rgyun du mchi bar nges pa yang / /de yang khyod kyis ma lus mkhyen/ /de slad yid gnyis mi mnga' khyod/ /gang gi lus kyis sems gang skyes/ /de yang khyod kyis rnam par mkhyen/ /sems de'i rgyu ni gang lags pa/ /de yang 'dren pas shin tu mkhyen/ /sngon chad gnas pa mkhyen pa ni/ /khyod dang 'dra ba yong ma mchis/ /sangs rgyas bye ba stong rnams dang / /'dren pa khyod ni de dang 'dra/ /srog chags so so'i dge ba rnams/ /rjes su dran pas rab tu mkhyen / /de slad sangs rgyas chos rnams la/ /'dren pa'i ye shes thogs mi snyemanga' / /gang dang gang gis 8lus kyis 9su/ /ji lta bu yi rgyud 1 du mchi/ /de yang thams cad mkhyen pas mkhyen/ /de slad rgyal bas lhag ma mchis/ /'dren pa chos rnams thams cad la/ /khyod ni the tshom yong mi mnga' sems can kun gyi spyod yul yang / /sangs rgyas spyan gyis rab tu gzigs/ /skye ba dang ni 'chi 11'pho mkhyen/ /khyod 'dra ba ni yong mi gda'/ /lhar bcas 'jig rten thams cad na/ /thub pa khyod las lhag ma mchis/ /zag pa zad pa'ang rab tu 54wa 736

mkhyen / /ma lus pa yang rtogs par gyur/ /nyon mongs thams cad yongs su spangs / /khyod kyis bag chags kun kyang bcom/ /sems can kun gyi nyon mongs dang / /spyod pa rnams kyang 'dren pas mkhyen/ /gang la nyon mongs spyod yul dang / /nyon mongs 'di dag gar 1'byung mkhyen/ /nyon mongs dag la spyad pas na/ /bag chags rjes su 'jug pa 2rnams/ /de dag kun kyang khyed mkhyen te/ /de las khyod ni pha rol phyin/ /bdag dang pha rol rnams dkyi yang ske/ /nyon mongs gang gis spong ba yi/ /lam de rnams kyang rab tu mkhyen/ /de slad khyod ni lam la mkhas/ /'jig rten kun mgon rnam 4'dren pa/ /mtha' yas brtson 'grus de bstod nas/ /bskal bye khrag khrig mtha' yas par/ /'gro ba gnyis su de skyes so/ /'di nas lha ris nga skyes te/ /rtag par lha yi dbang por gyur/ /bye ba mtha' yas lha rnams la/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes 'thob par bstan/ /lha yi gnas nas shi 'phos te/ /mi yi dbang po rgyal por gyur/ /sems can khrag khrig mtha' yas pa/ /rgyal ba'i ye shes 5thob par bstan/ /de dag nga yi chos thos nas/ /bste (tshostang mtshungs med bskyed nas su/ /sems ni 7thams cad nyer gzhag 8ste/ /dri med sems kyis de dag nyan/ /sems can bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /byang chub mchog la nges par 9gyur/ /nga yi tshig thos rtogs pa ni/ /sangs rgyas byang chub nges par gyur/ /sangs rgyas bye ba mtha' yas pa/ /sangs rgyas zhing gi rgya bshad kyang / /bskal pa khrag khrig mtha' yas su / /rgya chen bshad pa mi zad do/ /sangs rgyas yon tan gang brjod dang / /drang srong chen pos zhing bsngags pa/ /thams cad rang bzhin stong par bshad/ /de dag ma skyes mi 'gag bstan/ /gang 'dir sangs rgyas bsngags 2pa dang / /54—737

sangs rgyas yon tan gang bstan dang / /bde bar gshegs pas zhing brjod pa/ /gang gis bshad pa'ang de dang 'dra/ /chos rnams zhi bar bde gshegs bshad/ /zhi ba'i rang bzhin de mi rnyed/ /gang la bshad pa de yang stong / /'di la mgon med 'gro ba myos/ /de nas bram ze'i rigs shing sā la chen po lta bu'i bu mo blo gros mtha' yas kyis bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa brtson 'grus mtha' yas la tshigs su bcad pa de dag gis mngon par bstod nyanas bud med kyi dbang po las gyur te/ de phyin chad bud med kyi lus su mi skye bar gyur to/ /'jam dpal de lta bas na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po sangs rgyas kyi zhing tshad med pa yongs su sbyang bar 'dod cing bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas byang chub sems dpa'i rnam par thar pa sgrub dpa'i stong pa nyid sgrib pa med pa la bslab par bya'o/ /chos kyi rnam grangs 'di bshad pa'i tshe/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing 'di thams cad rnam par 'gyur ba drug tu g.yos te/ 'gul rab tu 'gul/kun du rab tu 'gul/ g.yos rab tu g.yos/ kun du rab tu g.yos/ ldeg rab tu ldeg /kun du rab tu ldeg /'khrugs rab tu 'khrugs/ kun du rab tu 'khrugs/ 'ur 'ur rab tu 'ur 'ur/ kun du rab tu 'ur 'ur/ chem chem rab tu chem chem/ kun du rab tu chem chem/ shar phyogs dma' na nub phyogs mtho/ nub phyogs dma' na shar phyogs mtho/ lho phyogs dma' na byang phyogs mtho/ byang phyogs dma' na lho phyogs mtho/ dbus dma' na mtha' mtho/mtha' dma' na dbus mtho bar gyur to/ /srog chags bye ba khrag khrig phrag drug cu rtsa drug len pa med par zag pa rnams las sems rnam par grol lo/ /dge 51—738

slong dang / dge slong ma dang/ dge bsnyen dang / dge bsnyen ma tshad med pa phrag brgya ni chos rnams la chos kyi mig rdul med cing dri ma dang bral ba rnam par dag go/ /byang chub sems dpa' bye ba khrag khrig dpag tu med pa ni mi skye ba'i chos la bzod pa thob par gyur to/ /srog chags stong phrag dpag tu med pa rnams dang / lha dang mir bcas pa'i skye dgu 1sngon sems ma bskyed pa rnams ni bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu sems skyes naso/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ byang chub sems dpa' brgyad khri bzhi stong po de dag dang / dge slong de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te 3bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa dkon mchog 'byung gnas zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sto // //rgya gar gyi mkhan po dzi zin mi tra 6dang / su ren dra bo dhi dang / zhu 7chen gyi lo tsā ba ban de 8ye shes sdes zhus te 9skad gsar chad 1 rikyis bcos nas slad kyis gtan la phab pa// //54—739

༄ga /'phags pa gser gyi mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄tshon /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya su baṇ+ḍi sru tra rnam hā yā na nā ma dasru tra/bod skad du/ 'phags pa gser gyi mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba na bzhugs te/ de'i tshe bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi sems ci ciltar blta bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo byang chub kyi sems ni gser dang rang bzhin 'dra bar gnas par blta bar bgyi'o/ /gser rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag pa ltar byang chub kyi sems rang bzhin gyis rnam par dag par gnas so//mgar bas gser la bzo'i bye brag tha dad par byas kyang gser rang bzhin mi 54—758

'gyur ba ltar/ byang chub kyi sems la yon tan khyad par sna tshogs par snang yang don dam par byang chub kyi sems las ma g.yos pas 1rang bzhin mi 'gyur ba'i phyir ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshigs su bcad de bka' stsal pa/byang chub sems nyid rnam par dag /bdag dang gzhan gyi don la brtson/ /dngos med ngo bo nyid du sgoman/ /shes rab skye ba'i rgyu la mos/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang /thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang / lha dang / mi dang / lha ma yin dang / dri zar bcas pa'i 'jig rten yi rangs te 3bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la mngon par bstod do// //'phags pa gser gyi mdo zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs sgo // //bsdur mchan/758 1mtshan byang 'di chos tshan 'di'i mtshan bod skad du smos pa ltar bkod/ na〈〈snar 〉〉brngo nā ma/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉waṇ+ḍi nā ma/ 5〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉 nā ma/ la〈〈zhol 〉〉ji/759 1〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉par/ 2〈〈co 〉〉bsgom/ 〈〈g.yung 〉〉〈〈pe 〉〉yid rangs te/ 〈〈zhol 〉〉yi rang ste/la〈〈snar 〉〉〈〈co 〉〉〈〈zhol 〉〉so/ /54wa 759

khog /'phags pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/1༄༅na /rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya su baṇ+ḍi nabā lu ko pa ma nā ma ma hā yā na sru tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa gser gyi bye ma lta bu zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo/ sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo/ /'di skad bdag gis 3thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das mnyan du yod pa na rgyal bu rgyal byed kyi tshal mgon med zas sbyin gyi kun dga' ra ba can dge slong stong nyis brgya lnga bcu'i dge slong gi dge 'dun chen po dang /byang chub sems dpa' stong phrag mang po dag dang thabs cig 5tu bzhugs te/de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo stan las langs te bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la 6btsugs te/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba 7btud nas bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag 51—761

par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dpag tu ma mchis pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das ci de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yon tan dpag tu ma mchis pa dang ldan lags sam/ de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni dpag tu med do/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni yon tan dpag tu med pa 1dang ldan no/ /tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos lan gnyis su bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das ci de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams dpag tu ma mchis pa lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das ci de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yon tan dpag tu ma mchis pa dang ldan lags sam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis kyang lan gnyis lan gsum du tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni dpag tu med do/ /kun dga' bo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ni yon tan dpag tu med pa dang yang 2ldan no/ /kun dga' bo khyod de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi dpag tu med pa mnyan pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yul shes pa'am/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi yon tan shes par 'dod dam/ de skad ces bka' stsal pa dang / bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang 54—762

ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /dge slong rnams la bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol/ bde bar gshegs pas bstan du gsol/dge slong rnams kyis mngon sum du thos na yang dag par 'dzin par 'gyur lags so/ /de skad ces gsol pa dang / bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kun dga' bo khyod kyis mod gal gyi bu chen po rdzu 'phrul ji lta bus phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag tu 'gro ba shes sam/ kun dga' bos gsol pa/ mod gal gyi bu chen po rdzu 'phrul ji lta bus phyogs dang phyogs mtshams dag tu mchi ba bcom ldan 'das kyis bstan du gsol / bde bar gshegs pas bstan du gsol/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo khyod la don 'di dpes bstan par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kun dga' bo skyes bu mkhas pa gang dag dpes don rtogs par 'gyur ba yod pa'i phyir ro/ /kun dga' bo dper na rdzing dpag tshad brgyad stong pa chus gang ba/ bya khus btung du rung bar mu dang kha da chad du 'dug pa/ pad ma'i lo mas khebs pa zhig yod la de nas mi la la zhig gis rlung gi shugs las 'das pa'i rta mchog dag dang ldan pa'i lcags kyi shing rta la zhon te/de yang mu 1khyad kyi shing yang chu la mi reg /rta rnams kyi mig pa yang chu la mi reg /pad ma'i lo ma rnams kyang rta'i mig pa dag gis mi brtol ba tsam gyi stobs dang shugs dang mgyogs pa de lta bus rgyug la/ kun dga' bo de nas rdzing de'i nang nas sbrul gdug 2pa zhig byung nas 3shing rta de mtsho'i nang nas phyir ma log pa de'i bar skabs su lashing rta de lan brgyad bskor na/ kun dga' bo sbrul gdug pas shing rta lan cig rabaskor ba'i yun ji tsam pa de'i bar 54wa 763

skabs 1su kun dga' bo khyod chos bstan pa rnam pa brgyad ston cing don kyang go bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo khyod tshig gcig smra ba'i yun ji tsam pa de'i bar skabs su mod gal gyi bu chen po chos bstan pa rnam pa brgyad ston cing don kyang go bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo mod gal gyi bu chen po tshig gcig smra ba'i yun ji tsam pa de'i bar skabs su gnas brtan sha nar dwa ti'i bu chos bstan pa rnam pa brgyad ston cing don kyang go bar byed do/ /gnas brtan sha dar dwa ti'i bu tshig gcig smra ba'i yun ji tsam pa de'i bar skabs su rang sangs rgyas chos bstan pa rnam pa grangs med pa ston to/ /rang sangs rgyas tshig gcig smra ba'i yun ji tsam pa de'i bar skabs su byang chub sems dpa' chos bstan pa rnam pa grangs med bsam gyis mi khyab cabarjod du med pa ston cing don kyang go bar byed do/ /kun dga' bo byang chub sems dpa' tshig gcig smra ba'i yun ji tsam pa de'i bar skabs gsu kun dga' bo gnas brtan mod gal gyi bu chen po 'jig rten gyi khams brgyad khri 'da'o/ /kun dga' bo rdzu 'phrul gyi stobs bskyed 6pa de lta 7bu'i 'gros kyis nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du ngal mi bso bar shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams ji snyed du 'gro ba dang / de bzhin du lho phyogs dang / nub phyogs dang / byang phyogs dang / de bzhin du shar lho'i phyogs namatshams dang ske/ lho nub kyi mtshams dang / nub byang gi mtshams dang / byang shar gyi mtshams dang / de bzhin du steng dang 'og gi phyogs su nyin mtshan bdun gyi bar du ngal mi bso bar song la/ de nas mi la la zhig gis phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag thams cad ra bas bskor te ra bas bskor nas rdo dang /gsog ma dang / gyo mo dang / gyo dum ‘ med par 0byas te mthon 11dman med 54—764

par byas nas grong khyer gcig tu byas la grong khyer gcig tu byas nas kyang yungs 'brus bkang ste byur bur byas na/ kun dga' bo grong khyer de'i nang gi yungs 'bru ji snyed yod 1pa de dag bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na sems can byang chub la zhugs pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris dag tu skye ba dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris dag na 'khod pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dga' ldan gyi lha'i ris dag nas 'chi 'pho ba dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams ma'i mngal du 'jug pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams ma'i mngal nas 'byung ba dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi nakhams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams byis pa'i rtsed mo ston pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na 3byang chub sems dpa' rnams rgyal srid spangs nas rab tu byung ba dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams dka' ba spyod pa'i sbyor ba ston pa dag ngas mthong ngo de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' 54—765

rnams byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba dag 1ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub kyi snying po la lta ba dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub kyi snying po la gces par byed pa'i mchog dang gus pa chen pos lan gsum bskor nab byed pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa dag ngas mthong ngo de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams byang chub kyi shing drung na 'dug pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na byang chub sems dpa' rnams bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi 5khams dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams chos kyi 'khor snyelo bskor ba dag ngas mthong ngo / /de bas kyang ches mang ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams dag na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa dag ngas mthong ste/ de dag thams cad kyang mtshan 'thun 5pa dang gdung 'thun /pa sha stag yin na 'jig rten gyi khams gang dag na byang chub sems dpa' 7chen po rnams mngon par 'byung ba dang / byang chub kyi snying por 'gro ba dang / byang chub kyi snying po la lta ba dang / byang chub kyi snying po la 54wa 766

bskor 1)ba byed pa dang / byang chub kyi snying po la 'dug pa dang / byang chub kyi shing drung na 'dug pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas chos kyi 'khor lo bskor nab dang / yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa chen po ston pa mtshan tha dad pa dang gdung tha dad pa dag rilta ci smos/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi 4khams gang dag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams mi 'byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa mi spyod pa'i 'jig rten gyi 5khams ji snyed cig 6rimachis lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo 'jig rten gyi khams ngas bstan pa gang dag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa gang yin pa de dag ni kun dga' bo dper na rgya mtsho chen po'i bye ma dang gang gā'i klung gi bye ma'i nang na gser gyi bye ma dkon pa dang 'dra ste/ kun dga' bo de bzhin du 'jig rten gyi khams gang dag tu sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams na'abyung ba dang ske/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag ni dkon te/ kun dga' bo ji ltar rgya mtsho chen po'i bye ma dang gang gā'i klung gi bye ma de dag las la la zhig gis bye ma 'bru 9gcig blangs pa de bzhin du gang du sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'byung ba dang / byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams de dag ni nyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' stsal nas/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bo dang / dge slong de dag 54—767
